There's something I'd like to tell you.
About the new witch who will soon appear...
strings.나르샤, 먼저 미안하다는 말을 할게요. 중요한 일이라 모험가님을 모셔가야: Narsha, let me apologize first. This is important, so I must borrow the adventurer for a while.
Yes, Your Majesty. I understand. I'll take my leave, then.
Narsha, let's have that meal later.
strings.(카이나의 손 인사와 함께 나르샤를 비롯해 멀리 서있던 기사들도 물러난다: (At Kaina's wave, Narsha and the knights standing some distance away withdraw.)
strings.이제 이야기할 수 있겠네요. 좀 갑작스럽죠?: Now we can talk. A little sudden, isn't it?
strings.제가 아는 폐하는 언제나 갑작스러웠어요. 마치 정해진 것처럼, 제가 일을: Your Majesty has always been sudden, as far as I know. As though it were all arranged, and you wanted me to take care of something...
You could have thought much worse of me. I'm glad that's all it is.
That isn't funny. Don't make jokes like that.
I only said it because I'm relieved.
strings.언니. 그 마녀가 누군지, 어디서 나타나는지 이야기해봐. 막연하게 말고,: Sister. Tell us who this witch is and where she'll appear. No vague hints. Everything.
strings.너도 알잖아. 나는 모든 걸 알 수 없어. 다른 사람보다 조금 더 일찍,: You know I can't know everything. I only learn little things a little sooner than other people.
strings.언니의 예언 중에 하나라도 사소한 게 있었어? 최근 일들도 그래. 언니는: Has even one of your prophecies ever been a little thing? Look at what's happened recently. The problem is that you think of it that way. Those events threatened to shake the whole world!
Don't take something that could have killed so many people lightly.
That isn't what I meant by little things, Dayna.
strings.언니 덕분에 목숨을 구한 일은 고맙지만, 알아야겠어. 대체 뭘 숨기는 거: I'm grateful you've saved lives, but I need to know. What are you hiding? How do you learn these things? Do you receive divine revelations? What is it?
Dayna, I can't tell you that.
It's always like this. You always hide things and run away.
strings.(사이가 좋지 않다는 건 알고 있었지만….): (I knew they didn't get along, but...)
I'm a fool for expecting anything from you.
strings.데이나, 나 이제 이야기할게. 그래도 되지?: Dayna, I'm going to explain now. May I?
strings.곧 나타날 마녀와 의회에 관한 거야. %s…, 둘 중 어떤 이야기를 먼저: It concerns the witch who will soon appear, and the council. %s... Which would you like to hear about first?
So there was more than one thing. Ugh...
strings.1. 곧 나타날 마녀: 1. The witch who will soon appear.
strings.이리스 님의 일을 하는 사람인 당신에게 앞으로도 계속 마녀가 나타날 거예: As someone who works for Lady Iris, you will continue to encounter witches.
Whether intentionally or otherwise. Just as with the witches you met on Aie Island...
They understand what it means to tamper with life...
strings.마녀들이 하려는 일…. 그런 건가요? 바이스가 하려고 했던 것처럼?: Is that what the witches are trying to do? Like what Weiss intended?
I cannot say that much. Every witch has a different goal.
strings.(키르케는 마녀니까 당연히 다른 마녀를 해쳐야 한다고 했고….): (Circe said that as a witch, she naturally had to harm other witches...)
strings.(힐다는 그냥 도망가기에 바빴어….): (Hilda was busy just trying to escape...)
%s, wait for the person who will soon come to see Dayna...
strings.(이제 곧 일이 일어난다는 익숙한 패턴….): (The familiar pattern of something being about to happen...)
strings.(폐하의 예언은 어디서 오는 걸까?): (Where do Her Majesty's prophecies come from?)
strings.의회는 제국 초기부터 황제에게 집중된 권력을 분산시키기 위해 귀족들이 모: The council is an institution the nobles formed early in the Empire's history to disperse the power concentrated in the emperor.
strings.오랜 시간 동안 제국을 위한다는 명목으로 일해왔지만, 언제부턴가 황실보다: For a long time, it has worked in the name of the Empire. But at some point, its voice grew louder than the imperial family's.
strings.의회가 마법사와 병사들을 움직여 마녀를 찾을 계획을 세웠어. 하지만, 그: The council plans to send mages and soldiers to find a witch. But they have almost no information about witches.
strings.의장인 아론이 움직인 이유가 그거였어?: Is that why Aaron, the chairman, made a move?
Ah! The man I saw at the Nereis Gateway... He said he did some minor work for the council...
strings.아론 칸델 티에네스. 제국 초창기부터 의회를 이끌어갔던 티에네스 가(家): Aaron Kandel Thienes. The current head of House Thienes, which has led the council since the Empire's earliest days.
strings.네레이스 관문에서 잠깐 본 적이 있어요. 계속해서 만날지도 모르겠다면서: I met him briefly at the Nereis Gateway. He mentioned witch-related business and said we might keep running into each other.
strings.그랬군요. 제가 일단 의회 소속 군사나 기사단의 움직임을 주시해달라고 아: I see. For now, I've asked Argent to watch the movements of the council's troops and knight orders.
strings.민심이 동요할 수 있기도 하고, 의회가 전면으로 나서는 일은 막아야 하니: The public could become unsettled, and we must prevent the council from taking overt action...
We must avoid a clash between the council and the witches as far as possible.
Do you think that's possible now that the council has acted? Surely you don't mean...
Dayna, I have a separate favor to ask you.
We can get a little closer to what happened ten years ago.
I'll handle that. Stay out of it, Sister. Just focus on governing.
strings.데이나, 네 뜻도 알아. 하지만, 나는 제국의 황제면서 아버지의 딸, 그: Dayna, I understand your wishes. But I am not only the Empire's ruler. I am Father's daughter and your older sister.
strings.그동안 내 자리에서 뭘 할 수 있을지를 고민했고, 노력했어. 그렇게 이제: All this time, I've thought about what I could do from my position, and I've worked toward it. Now, at last, I think I can do something...
strings.왜 하지 말라는 거야?: Why are you telling me not to?
Enough. I don't want to hear it. If you're finished talking, go back now.
strings.(그때, 데이나가 뒷걸음질 치는 한 여성을 쫓아가 붙잡는다.): (Just then, Dayna goes after a woman who is backing away and catches her.)
I seem to have picked the wrong moment. Ahaha...
Not at all, Chloris. You've come at just the right time.
strings.(클로리스라고 불린 여성이 고개를 흔들 때마다 에메랄드 빛을 머금은 금발: (As the woman called Chloris shakes her head, her emerald-tinged blond hair moves with it.)
strings.%s 씨는 클로리스 씨와 구면이지?: %s, you've met Chloris before, haven't you?
Ah, the Magic Academy's headmistress! You looked different then, so I didn't recognize you.
strings.제발 그 모습은 잊어주세요. 학생들이 선생님이 학교 부순다고 놀려대서 부: Please forget that appearance. The students keep teasing me about their teacher destroying the school. It's embarrassing.
strings.그런데 클로리스 씨, 저를 찾아오신 거 맞죠? 시이나에게 무슨 일이라도…: Chloris, you came to see me, didn't you? Has something happened to Shiina...?
There is nothing wrong with the princess... I mean, Shiina. However...
strings.클로리스, 이야기를 듣고 싶은데, 자리를 옮길까요?: Chloris, I'd like to hear what you have to say. Shall we move somewhere else?
strings.데이나, 이왕이면 젤릭의 디저트를 먹으면서 이야기를 듣고 싶어. 그래도: Dayna, if possible, I'd like to hear this over Jelic's desserts. Would that be all right?
Do what you like. You always do.
strings.고마워, 데이나. 그리고 클로리스하고 %s. 몽글몽글 길드의 파티시에가: Thank you, Dayna. Chloris and %s, let's go see the Mongle Mongle Guild's pastry chef.
strings.데이나, 내 이야기 들을 거지?: Dayna, you'll listen to me, won't you?
Ugh, fine. I'll listen. Happy now?
strings.역시 젤릭 음식은 행복 그 자체…. 이런 맛이 에스닐에만 있다니 너무 아: Jelic's food truly is happiness itself... It's such a shame this flavor can only be found in Esnil.
Thank you from me too, Jelic. The students asked me to tell you they enjoyed the bread.
It was worth gathering the guild members to bake it, then. Haha. Oh, here, take this.
strings.별건 아니지만, 고향 마을 방식으로 만든 음식 저장 주머니에요. 간단하게: It's nothing much, but this is a food-storage pouch made using a method from my home village. I've packed a few things to eat. Please take it with you when you leave.
I have more food to prepare, so I'll take my leave. Enjoy your time together.
Jelic would make a fine imperial pastry chef...
strings.혼잣말이었어. 그런데 젤릭을 칭찬해서 한 소리가 왜, 무슨 문제야?: I was talking to myself. And what's wrong with complimenting Jelic?
strings.내가 황성에 있지 못하는 이유를 알면서도 젤릭에게 그러는 거야?: You know why I can't stay in the imperial palace, yet you say that to him?
You left by your own choice. Even though I told you it was all right...
strings.언니가 괜찮다면 다 괜찮은 거야?!: Does everything become all right just because you say so?!
strings.실바리아 제국의 황제, 카이나 던 실바리아가 명을 내려서 붙잡을 수도 있: I could have kept you there by order of Kaina Dawn Silvaria, Empress of the Silvaria Empire. I respected your wishes, and yet you...
strings.그래서 뭐? 여기서 명이라도 내릴 생각이야?: And? Are you going to issue an order here?
strings.(데이나와 카이나가 쉬지 않고 계속해서 불만을 드러낸다. 두 사람 사이에: (Dayna and Kaina continue airing their grievances without pause. Caught between them, Chloris looks deeply uneasy.)
strings.폐하, 그리고 데이나 씨. 클로리스 님 이야기를 들으려고 여기 계신 거: Your Majesty, Dayna. Didn't we come here to hear Chloris's story?
I'm sorry, Chloris. My sister distracted me.
Forgive me, Chloris. It's been a while since I spent time with my sister.
Ahaha, no, it's all right. I'm fine.
strings.클로리스, 제피로스를 찾고 싶어서 시이나 소개로 온 거죠?: Chloris, Shiina sent you here because you want to find Zephyros, correct?
How did Your Majesty...? Ah... Right.
strings.제피로스가 마법 연구에 필요한 재료 때문에 출장을 갔는데, 보름이 넘게: Zephyros went away to obtain materials for his magical research, but he hasn't returned in over a fortnight.
So I came to ask Dayna for help.
strings.연구를 위해 조금 더 출장지에 계시는 건 아니고요?: Could he be staying a little longer to continue his research?
No, that's not it... It's a little embarrassing to say...
Since the accident at the academy festival, I've been able to sense Zephyros's magic.
strings.얼마나 멀리서도 느껴지는지 제피로스가 리프트라시르로 갔을 때도 느낄 수: I could feel it from so far away that I still sensed him when he went to Lifthrasir.
strings.클로리스 씨의 일도 돕고 싶지만, 폐하의 일도 도와드려야 할 것 같아서…: I'd like to help you too, but I think I must also assist Her Majesty...
strings.(데이나 씨, 결국 폐하의 부탁을 들어드리는 거네….): (So Dayna is going to do what Her Majesty asked after all...)
strings.아니에요, 괜찮아요. 다른 분을 찾아볼게요. 말씀 들어주신 것만으로도 감: No, it's all right. I'll find someone else. Thank you just for hearing me out. I can't go to Lifthrasir myself...
strings.왜요? 엘프인데, 왜 알프헤임에 갈 수 없다고 하세요?: Why? You're an elf. Why can't you go to Alfheim?
Chloris, it's all right. There is nowhere a citizen of the Silvaria Empire cannot go.
Help her find Zephyros. It will bring you closer to the answers you seek. I say this through my ability, so you may trust it.
Understood. With Your Majesty's assurance, things surely won't go wrong.
strings.폐하, 정말 제가 가도 괜찮을까요?: Your Majesty, is it really all right for me to go?
strings.아무리 안하무인인 자라도 황제의 사람을 건드리면 안 된다는 걸 알고 있을: Even the most arrogant person knows better than to lay a hand on someone under the Empress's protection. Go without fear.
strings.폐하 말씀을 들으니 제가 잠시 망설인게 후회돼요. 어차피 제가 가야 그를: Hearing that, I regret hesitating at all. I knew I had to go myself to find him.
strings.실바리아 제국 사람인 걸 잊지 마요. 그러면 준비되는 대로 네레이스 관문: Do not forget that you are a citizen of the Silvaria Empire. When you're ready, go to the Nereis Gateway and speak to Notos. He will open the gate.
What...? Notos? Did you say Notos? Notos... Aaah...
strings.그러면 두분, 만나서 반가웠어요. 저는 까칠한 동생과 할 이야기가 있어서: It was lovely to meet you both. I have something to discuss with my prickly little sister, so I'll take my leave.
strings.후우, 바보 언니 때문에 번거롭게 해드렸네요. 언니, 딱 5분만이야. 그: Sigh. My foolish sister has caused you trouble. Sister, five minutes. Not a moment more.
strings.(두 사람이 이야기를 나누기 위해 어디론가 사라지자 클로리스가 식은 땀을: (As the two disappear somewhere to talk, Chloris wipes away a cold sweat.)
I truly never imagined I'd meet Her Majesty like this...
strings.학원제 일은 다시 한 번 감사드려요. 아, 이제 학원제 이름이 바뀔 거예: Thank you again for what happened at the academy festival. Oh, the festival will have a new name now.
strings.저기 %s 님, 폐하의 말씀이 있긴 했지만, 저와 동행하는 거 괜찮으시겠: Um, %s. Her Majesty did ask, but are you really all right with accompanying me?
It's all right. There's something I'd like to investigate too.
strings.%s 님이 함께 하신다면 중요한 일이겠죠?: If you're involved, %s, it must be important.
strings.폐하께서 곧 나타날 새로운 마녀에 관해 데이나 씨와 이야기하려고 에스닐에: Her Majesty came to Esnil to speak to Dayna about a new witch who will soon appear.
And since she told me to accompany you...
That means the witch could be in Lifthrasir.
strings.(순간, 클로리스가 뭔가 결심한듯 비장한 표정을 짓는다.): (For an instant, Chloris looks resolute, as though she has made a decision.)
strings.%s 님. 저 학교로 돌아가 짐을 챙겨올게요. 준비가 되면 네레이스 관문: %s, I'll return to the academy and pack. Come to the Nereis Gateway when you're ready.
All right. I'll go to the Nereis Gateway once I'm prepared.
strings.(학원제의 일이 거기서 끝난 줄 알았는데, 이렇게 이어지다니…. 언제나: (I thought the academy festival business was over, but now it's continuing like this... As always, I suppose I can only go and see.)
strings.(다시 찾은 네레이스 관문, 프레이오스 대륙의 서부와 동부를 건너는 많은: (The Nereis Gateway is once again crowded with people traveling between eastern and western Freios.)
strings.(사람들을 헤치고 보이는 커다란 건물 앞에 다가가자 뭔가 고민하고 있는: (Pushing through the crowd toward the large building ahead, I see Chloris from behind, apparently worrying about something.)
strings.저도 도착한지 얼마 안됐어요. 아, 저…. 클로리스라고 이름을 편하게 불: I only just got here myself. Oh, um... Would you please call me Chloris?
It's a little embarrassing to be called headmistress or principal outside the academy.
strings.그래도 이름만 부를 순 없으니 데이나 씨처럼 부를까요?: Then shall I address you as I do Dayna? I'd still like to be respectful.
That sounds good. I'll do the same for you, %s.
There's a lounge inside. You could have waited there.
...I made a mistake with Notos once...
strings.설마 노토스 님을 제피로스 님으로 착각해서 고백했다던가, 뒤에서 껴안았다: Don't tell me you mistook him for Zephyros and confessed your love, hugged him from behind, or gave him a present?
strings.(클로리스가 당황한 표정을 짓다가 아무렇지도 않은 척 행동하려 한다.): (Chloris looks flustered, then tries to act as though nothing is wrong.)
N-nothing happened! Oh, someone's coming out.
strings.(관문 센터의 문이 열리고, 그 안에서 누군가 걸어나온다. 그러다 %s의: (The Gateway Center's door opens, and someone steps out. Spotting %s, he offers a warm greeting.)
strings.이게 몇 년 만이죠?: How many years has it been?
strings.그동안 어떻게 지내셨나요? 마법학원 학원장이 되셨다는 이야기는 들었었는데: How have you been? I heard you became the Magic Academy's headmistress...
strings.학원제에서 고생하신 건 괜찮으신가요?: Have you recovered from your troubles at the academy festival?
Yes, well... I came to the gateway because I have business in Lifthrasir.
strings.폐하의 명으로 게이트 점검을 끝냈습니다. 안쪽에 있는 게이트웨이를 이용하: I've finished checking the gate on Her Majesty's orders. Please use the gateway inside.
It was nothing. I'm simply grateful you always look after my younger brother.
strings.(아, 노토스 님은 아직 제피로스 님 이야기를 모르나보네.): (Ah, Notos must not know about Zephyros yet.)
strings.제피로스와 헤어진 것에 대해 미안해하실 필요는 없습니다. 분명 제피로스가: You needn't apologize for breaking up with Zephyros. I'm sure he was the one at fault. Hahaha.
That's right. Zephy was the one... I'm sorry. I didn't mean to speak ill of him...
It's all right. You're saying it because you care about him.
Notos, I'll be going now. We're short on time...
strings.(클로리스가 등을 돌리고 서둘러 게이트 웨이로 뛰어간다.): (Chloris turns and hurries toward the gateway.)
%s, don't worry about me. Hurry after Chloris.
Thank you. I'll see you again later.
strings.(클로리스가 강력한 마력으로 움직이고 있는 게이트를 바라보고 있다.): (Chloris stands looking at the gate, which hums with powerful magic.)
It's been a very long time since I went to Alfheim.
I hope this isn't rude to say, but you look a little anxious.
strings.맞아요. 조금 불안해요. 저는 알프헤임에선 환영받지 못했거든요. 물론,: I am. A little. I wasn't welcome in Alfheim. Though the Silvaria Empire didn't exactly welcome me warmly either.
I'm half human and half elf. There weren't many places that would accept me because of that.
strings.지금은 괜찮아요. 학교에 있는 것만으로도 그런 건 잊고 지낼 수 있었거든: I'm all right now. Simply being at the academy has allowed me to forget about it.
strings.학생들을 가르치는 동료 마법사들도 크게 신경 쓰지 않는 것 같고, 절 따: My fellow mages who teach the students don't seem to mind, and many students look up to me.
strings.(클로리스가 환한 미소를 짓는다. 방금 전까지 불안해 보이던 표정은 온데: (Chloris smiles brightly. The anxiety from a moment ago is nowhere to be seen.)
You really love the academy, don't you?
I'm a little sad that I never got to enroll, but I'm so happy to be there even in this way.
Though I still hate going to work when there's too much to do.
Haha. I think everyone feels that way.
strings.(게이트 앞에 다가가는 순간, 주위가 갑자기 어두워진다.): (As we approach the gate, the surroundings suddenly grow dark.)
strings.%s 씨도 느꼈죠?: You felt that too, didn't you, %s?
strings.지금 이 앞에 어두워진 거 맞죠?: It just went dark in front of us, didn't it?
Yes. Someone is giving us a silent warning not to come.
It seems they've set a little device here... But they've picked the wrong person.
strings.(클로리스가 눈을 감은 채로 손을 뻗자 허공해에서 흐르던 차가운 바람이: (Chloris closes her eyes and reaches out. Cold wind from the Void Sea flows in and coils around her hand. A plant stem sprouts within it.)
strings.(클로리스의 손짓에 따라 줄기에서 떨어진 잎이 바람을 타고 게이트의 주위: (At Chloris's gesture, leaves fall from the stem, ride the wind, and circle the gate.)
strings.(그러자 어두웠던 주위의 풍경이 천천히 맑고 깨끗한 원래의 네레이스 관문: (The darkened surroundings slowly return to the clear, bright Nereis Gateway.)
strings.(클로리스가 방긋 웃자 어느새 손에 감겨 있던 바람도, 식물의 줄기도 천: (As Chloris smiles, the wind and plant stem around her hand slowly disappear.)
strings.이것도 윈디 시드의 영향이에요…. 지팡이나 마법서를 들지 않아도 마법을: This is another effect of the Windy Seed... I can cast magic without holding a staff or spellbook now. I consider it a rather nice gift.
Space and time were slightly distorted here.
Since the academy festival, I've felt something strange that I can't put into words.
strings.그 원인을 찾고 싶어서 오래된 마법서들을 읽었는데, 정확한 답은 없었어요: I read old spellbooks to find the cause, but there was no clear answer. All I can do is experience it, sense it, and learn...
A spirit of time I once met remembered Zephyros transforming into a being like itself.
strings.정령이 말해준 거면…. 제피로스가 시간의 영향을 받은 건 확실한게 됐네요: If a spirit told you that... then it's certain Zephyros was affected by time. Hmm...
strings.%s 씨, 이제 갈까요? 여기서 아무리 이야기해도 답은 나오지 않을 거예: %s, shall we go now? Talking here won't give us any answers.
strings.(클로리스가 마른 침을 삼키고 천천히 리프트라시르 방향 게이트 안으로 들: (Chloris swallows nervously and slowly enters the gate to Lifthrasir. %s follows behind.)
strings.(허공해의 하늘 위에서 두 사람이 게이트 사이로 사라진 걸 확인한 누군가: (High above the Void Sea, someone watches the two disappear through the gate and exclaims in wonder.)
strings.우와, 우와, 우와!! 자물쇠다, 자물쇠!: Wow, wow, wow!! A lock! A lock!
strings.기억 속에 있던 진짜 자물쇠야! 우와, 우와!!: It's the real lock from my memories! Wow, wow!!
strings.(클로리스의 말과 함께 맑고 푸른 하늘 아래로 보라빛으로 물든 마을의 모: (As Chloris speaks, a village washed in purple spreads out beneath a clear blue sky.)
strings.(엘프 마을 특유의 분위기가 가득한 건물들 사이로 하늘을 향해 검을 들고: (Among buildings steeped in the atmosphere of an elven village stands an enormous statue of an elf raising a sword toward the sky.)
strings.저건 전설의 엘프 용사 석상이에요. 용사의 이름은 알려져 있진 않지만,: That's a statue of the legendary elven hero. Their name isn't known, but they fought the demons that appeared on Freios.
If you'd like to know more, you could attend one of Professor Theodore's lectures.
I'd like to, if I get the chance.
Or you could ask the villagers.
strings.인간 마을과는 조금 다른 느낌이 들어요. 공기가 더 깨끗하고 맑다고 해야: It feels a little different from a human town. The air seems clearer and cleaner...
strings.근처에 있는 숲 때문이에요. 아무래도 수정달 숲이 정령의 영향을 받아서…: It's because of the nearby forest. Crystal Moon Forest is influenced by spirits... But what's that orange ribbon on your wrist?
strings.어라…. 이거 언제부터 있었던 거지?: Huh...? When did that get there?
strings.게이트로 들어오면서 다른 사람 옷에서 떨어진게 붙은 것 같아요. 크게 신: It must have fallen from someone else's clothes and caught on you as we entered the gate. Don't worry too much about it. For now, let's...
strings.(클로리스가 말을 이어가려는 순간, 리프트라시르의 주민으로 보이는 금발: (Just as Chloris is about to continue, a blond elf boy who appears to be a Lifthrasir resident approaches.)
strings.나는 코렌이야! 반가워! 가이드해줄게! 우리 마을은 전설 속 엘프 용사의: I'm Coren! Nice to meet you! I'll show you around! Our village is the birthplace of the legendary elven hero...
strings.(자신을 코렌이라고 소개한 엘프 소년이 클로리스와 눈이 마주친다.): (The boy who introduced himself as Coren meets Chloris's eyes.)
The birthplace of the elven hero... Aaaaah...
strings.(코렌이 클로리스와 눈이 마주치자 마자 슬금슬금 뒤로 물러난다. 그러더니: (The instant Coren meets Chloris's eyes, he begins backing away. Then he turns and runs.)
strings.소개하다가 말고 왜 도망가는 거지?: Why did he run off in the middle of the introduction?
strings.프레이오스 엘프는 본능적으로 다른 피가 섞인 존재들을 느껴요. 그리고 그: Freios elves instinctively sense beings with mixed blood. They see it as something impure, rather than simply different.
That boy probably did too. It's been ingrained in them since ancient times.
strings.보통은 그냥 안 좋은 시선으로만 볼 뿐인데…. 저렇게 도망가는 걸 보면: Usually, they just give me hostile looks... If he's running away like that, perhaps something has happened.
Still, that's no way to treat a person.
Though I know it isn't only elves...
strings.%s 씨, 이 이야기는 여기서 하지 않았으면 좋겠어요. 지금 그것보다 중: %s, I'd rather not discuss this here. We have something more important to do right now.
Ah, I'm sorry. I wasn't thinking.
strings.괜찮아요. 리프트라시르 사람들과 이야기하다보면 이런 일이 계속해서 일어날: It's all right. Things like this will keep happening as we talk to Lifthrasir's people.
Please focus on what you came here to do, %s.
strings.고마워요. 그러면 다른 사람들에게 물어보러 갈까요?: Thank you. Shall we go ask someone else, then?
strings.(클로리스가 발걸음을 멈추고, 한 인간 남성을 바라본다.): (Chloris stops walking and looks at a human man.)
strings.(고급스러운 코트를 대충 걸치고, 번쩍거리는 장신구를 착용한 남자가 클로: (A man with an expensive coat thrown loosely over his shoulders and glittering accessories notices Chloris and gives her a broad smile.)
strings.오, 클로리스 학원장께서 여기는 무슨 일이야?: Oh, Headmistress Chloris. What brings you here?
Hahaha! What else? I go wherever there's money to be made.
strings.리프트라시르의 촌장이 이곳 물건을 제국으로 유통하고 싶어해서 내가 먼저: Lifthrasir's village chief wants to distribute local goods in the Empire, so I came to take a look first.
Chloris, if you know him, please introduce us.
strings.날 몰라? 그러면 알려주지. 나는 제국 최고의 상단 [리치베리]의 총수,: You don't know me? Then allow me to enlighten you. I'm Lashur, head of [Richberry], the Empire's greatest trading company. Remember it.
strings.나와 아는 사이라고 하면 적어도 손해는 보지 않을 거야. 나는 그런 사람: Tell people you know me, and you won't lose out, at least. That's the kind of man I am.
I was about to introduce you, but you beat me to it.
An introduction is always most impressive when you do it yourself, Headmistress.
strings.%s 씨, 라슈르 씨께선 매분기마다 학생들을 위해 써달라면서 계속 고액의: %s, Lashur donates large sums of Ely every quarter for the students.
strings.하하하, 그정도 가지고 뭘. 리치베리의 총수라면 당연히 해야 할 일. 그: Hahaha! It's nothing. As Richberry's head, it's only natural. But I'm curious about you. Please introduce yourself.
strings.%s? 들어본 것 같군. 내가 들어봤다면 너도 보통내기는 아니겠지. 하하: %s? I think I've heard of you. If I have, you must be someone special. Hahaha! A pleasure to meet you.
strings.리프 촌장이랑 만날 시간이 좀 남았는데, 심심하네. 학원장하고 너, 잠깐: I have some time before meeting Chief Lif, and I'm bored. Headmistress, would you and your friend talk with me for a while?
Of course, I won't take your time for nothing. I'll compensate you generously.
I'm sorry, Lashur. We have something to do.
strings.혹시 이사장님을 여기서 본 적이 있나요?: Have you seen the chairman here, by any chance?
The chairman? Chairman Zephyros came too? I only just arrived, so I haven't seen him.
strings.걱정하실 만한 그런 일은 아니에요. 그러면 저희는 바빠서 이만 물러날게요: Nothing you need to worry about. We're rather busy, so we'll take our leave.
strings.좋아, 학원장. 그러면 나중에 보자고. 학생들이 좋아할만한 걸 들고 갈테: All right, Headmistress. See you later. I'll bring something the students will enjoy!
strings.(라슈르가 손을 들어 멋들어진 인사를 하고, 마을 어딘가로 사라진다.): (Lashur raises a hand in a stylish farewell, then disappears into the village.)
strings.조금이 아니에요. 아주 많이죠. 대화하다 보면 좀 지치지만, 괜찮은 분이: Not just a little. Very. Talking to him can be tiring, but he's a good man.
He builds facilities for the students and donates money for teaching materials. I didn't expect to see him here.
strings.이제 이곳에 구면인 제국 사람은 없는 것 같으니 엘프들에게도 이야기를 물: It seems there are no more imperial acquaintances here. Let's ask the elves too.
Then we can go see the village chief, Lif.
strings.(코렌이 자신 앞으로 다가온 %s 일행을 빤히 바라본다.): (Coren stares at %s and their companion as they approach.)
strings.갑자기 왜 도망갔어요?: Why did you suddenly run away?
I'm sorry. I know I did something wrong. I knew it was wrong, but I was scared.
strings.역시 저 때문이죠?: It was because of me, wasn't it?
strings.(클로리스가 %s의 어깨를 붙잡고, 고개를 젓는다.): (Chloris takes %s by the shoulder and shakes her head.)
I understand, Coren. If you've realized it was wrong, that's enough.
strings.(나르샤 같은 사람도 수인이라며 같은 사람으로 보지 않았던 제국 사람들이: (It reminds me of the Empire's people who refused to see someone like Narsha as a person, calling her beastfolk. And elves treat mixed-blood people like this too...)
strings.(나도 무의식 중에 누군갈 편견으로 대하고 그러진 않았을까….): (Have I ever treated someone with prejudice without realizing it...?)
I won't do it again. It's been so long since I saw someone of mixed blood. And long ago...
Something bad happened in the village, that's all.
There's something I'd like to ask.
As long as it's not about the past.
strings.친구를 찾고 있어요. 우리들보다 먼저 리프트라시르에 왔는데, 소식이 끊겼: I'm looking for a friend. He came to Lifthrasir before us, but we've lost contact with him.
Really? Tell me what he looks like. I have a good memory, so I'll know right away.
strings.노토스 님과 쌍둥이니까 제가 설명 해도 될까요?: He's Notos's twin. Shall I describe him?
I'll do it. They're twins, but a little different.
strings.감람석 같은 초록색 눈동자고, 책을 읽을 땐 검은 안경을 쓴 인간 남자에: He's a human man with peridot-green eyes. He wears black glasses when he reads.
strings.항상 굳은 표정이긴 하지만, 가끔 미소 지을 때가 있는데 부드러워요. 제: His expression is usually stern, but sometimes he gives a gentle smile. He should be wearing a mage's outfit with the imperial crest.
Ah, that man! I think I saw him...
strings.(코렌이 기억을 더듬어가던 중, 당황한 표정을 보인다.): (As Coren searches his memory, he begins to look confused.)
It's all right. So many people visit that you may not remember everyone.
strings.(클로리스의 얼굴에 살짝 실망한 기색이 보인다.): (A hint of disappointment crosses Chloris's face.)
strings.우리 마을엔 언제까지 있을 거야?: How long will you stay in our village?
We'll leave as soon as we find him.
strings.그런데 마법사 복장을 입고 있었다면 마법사야?: If he was dressed as a mage, is he one?
strings.(마법사라는 말에 코렌의 눈빛이 반짝거리기 시작한다.): (Coren's eyes begin sparkling at the word mage.)
strings.와아, 마법사! 나 마법사 본적 없어! 신기해!: Wow, a mage! I've never seen one before! Amazing!
strings.코렌, 나중에라도 생각나면 이야기해줘요. 그러면 간단한 마법을 보여줄게요: Coren, if you remember anything later, please tell me. Then I'll show you a little magic.
strings.정말? 정말이야! 알았어, 누나!: Really? You mean it?! All right, big sis!
strings.(클로리스가 코렌이 태도를 달리하자 쓴 웃음을 보인다.): (Chloris gives a wry smile at Coren's change of attitude.)
Call me... Chloris. If that's too long, Chloe is fine.
Then we'll go speak to another elf. Thank you, Coren.
strings.(키가 큰 은발의 청년 엘프가 자신에게 다가오는 %s 일행을 빤히 바라보: (A tall, silver-haired young elf stares at %s and their companion as they approach.)
strings.저기요, 리프트라시르 주민이시죠? 뭐 좀 여쭤봐도 될까요?: Excuse me. You live in Lifthrasir, right? Could I ask you something?
W-what is it? I'm shy around strangers, and I'm a little slow to speak... I'm sorry...
Thank you for visiting our village. I'm Lunton, the keeper of Crystal Moon Forest. Have you come from the Empire?
strings.네…. 동부에서 왔어요. 그런데 지금 괜찮으신가요?: Yes... From the east. Are you all right?
strings.네, 괜찮습니다. 어떤 걸 물어보시려고…. 혹시 저분과 관련된 일입니까?: Yes, I'm fine. What would you like to ask...? Is it about your companion?
strings.(순간 런튼과 클로리스의 눈이 마주친다.): (Lunton and Chloris meet each other's eyes for an instant.)
A friend arrived in Lifthrasir before us, but we haven't been able to contact him.
strings.제국 사람들이 보면 왜 그러지 싶을 수도 있지만, 알프헤임의 엘프들은 혼: People of the Empire may wonder why, but the elves of Alfheim see those of mixed blood...
You don't need to explain that. There's really no problem with them...
In our village, something bad involving a person of mixed blood...
Even so... Ah, never mind. This is Alfheim...
strings.혹시 최근 숲과 마을을 방문한 사람 중에 제피로스란 분이 있을까요?: Has someone named Zephyros visited the forest or village recently?
strings.제피로스? 이름은 잘 모르겠지만, 인상착의를 말씀해주신다면 알 수 있을지: Zephyros? I don't know the name, but if you describe him, I might recognize him...
strings.아…. 클로리스 씨. 제피로스 님 인상착의를 설명해주셔야 할 것 같은데…: Ah... Chloris. I think you'll need to describe Zephyros...
strings.그분은 인간이고, 키는 저보다 더 커요. 감람석 같은 초록색 눈동자를 가: He's human, taller than I am. He has peridot-green eyes and wears black glasses.
strings.항상 굳은 표정이긴 하지만, 가끔 미소 지을 때가 있는데 부드러워요. 그: His expression is usually stern, but sometimes he gives a gentle smile. He should be wearing a mage's outfit with the imperial crest.
strings.혹시 마법서 같은 걸 들고 있나요?: Does he carry something like a spellbook?
strings.죄송합니다. 마법사가 흔치 않게 방문하긴 하는데…. 갑자기 기억이 나질: I'm sorry. Mages do visit occasionally... But all of a sudden, I can't remember...
It can't be helped. So many people visit this place...
If anything comes back to me later, I'll let you know immediately.
Yes... Then I hope you have a pleasant journey... I need to go on patrol...
strings.(작은 엘프 소녀가 분주하게 뛰어다니던 중, 자신에게 다가오는 %s 일행: (A small elf girl, busily running about, notices %s and their companion approaching.)
strings.리프트라시르에 어서오세요! 질문은 언제나 환영, 궁금한 게 있으면 리프를: Welcome to Lifthrasir! Questions are always welcome. If you're curious about anything, come see Lif. Ah...
(The elf girl who introduced herself as Lif stops moving when she sees Chloris.)
strings.촌장이라고 하셔서 무심코 네, 하고 대답할 뻔 했네요. 어서오세요, 클로: You called me chief, and I nearly answered without thinking. Welcome, Headmistress Chloris.
strings.네, 소장님. 오랜만에 뵙네요. 학원제 이후로 처음 뵙죠?: Yes, Director. It's been a while. We haven't met since the academy festival, have we?
That's right. Thank you for inviting me to the festival two years ago.
And please accept my apologies for the villagers' rudeness.
It's all right. I'm used to it. Please don't worry.
They're all good children, but... They carry some trauma from what happened before.
I heard a little in passing. Something happened in the village?
strings.옛날 일이랍니다. 학원장님께선 신경쓰실 일이 아니에요. 학원장님, 옆에: An old matter. Nothing you need concern yourself with, Headmistress. Would you introduce your companion?
strings.여기는 %s 씨입니다. 아실지 모르겠지만, 제레니스 학원 일도 도와주시고: This is %s. You may have heard of them: a hero who helped Xerenis Academy and resolved troubles on other continents as well.
No, I wouldn't go that far.
Ah! So you're the one. I've heard about you.
strings.나중에 노년을 리프트라시르에서 보내시면 어떨까요? 전설 속 용사와 함께: Why not spend your old age in Lifthrasir? A new hero laid to rest alongside our legendary champion... Has a nice ring to it, doesn't it?
I'm still very much alive, you know.
I'd rather not start planning for that yet.
strings.(돈 벌 생각을 바로 하는걸 보면 보통이 아닌 분이네.): (She's already thinking of making money from it. Quite a character.)
strings.학원장님, 무슨 일로 오셨어요? 혹시 실바리아 제국에서 협조 요청 공문이: Headmistress, what brings you here? We received an official request for cooperation from the Silvaria Empire. Is it about that?
strings.(리프가 품에서 종이를 하나 꺼내 읽기 시작한다.): (Lif takes out a sheet of paper and begins reading.)
strings.리프트라시르 관리소는 협조 바랍니다. 마을 방문자 1인에 대한 정보를 방: The Lifthrasir administration is requested to cooperate. Please provide visitors Chloris and %s with information concerning one visitor to the village...
strings.제국 건국 초기에도 이런 일은 없었는데, 뭘까요?: Even in the Empire's earliest days, we never had anything like this. What's going on?
strings.아하하, 말이 그렇다는 거죠. 실없는 농담은 그만할테니까, 찾는 분에 대: Ahaha, it's just a figure of speech. Enough silly jokes. Tell me about the person you're looking for.
It's Zephyros. Chloris will describe him.
strings.그렇게 부드럽진 않았는데요? 저렇게 어색하게 웃는 인간도 다 있구나 싶었: He wasn't that gentle, though. I remember thinking I'd never seen a human smile so awkwardly...
strings.신분을 밝히고, 마법 도구의 재료를 구하러 간다고 해서 허락했어요. 극소: He identified himself and said he was gathering materials for magical tools, so I allowed it. Only because he needed a tiny amount. Otherwise, I wouldn't have.
strings.얼마나 채취했는지 돌아와서 보고해줬으면 하고 기다렸는데, 오지를 않았어요: I asked him to report back with how much he gathered, but he never came.
strings.혹시 몰라서 런튼에게는 숲을 수색하라고 했고, 코렌에게는 숙소를 확인하라: Just in case, I told Lunton to search the forest and Coren to check the lodgings. When they couldn't find him, I assumed he'd gone straight home.
strings.그러면 두분께 수정달 숲 일반 구역 말고 그외 제한 구역도 출입을 허가할: Then I'll grant you access to the restricted areas of Crystal Moon Forest as well as the public areas.
strings.숲지기인 런튼에게도 이야기를 해둘 테니까, 숲을 헤맬 것 같으면 숲 중앙: I'll tell Lunton, the forest keeper, too. If you think you're getting lost, find him at the rest area in the center of the forest.
They say a favor should be repaid twice over, don't they? I'll look forward to it.
strings.저는 일이 많아서 여러분과 함께 숲으로 못 갈거 같아요. 여기 지도도 있: I have too much work to join you in the forest. Here's a map, and there are signposts outside. You shouldn't get lost.
You've done so much for us already. The thought is more than enough.
I'll gather information here too, so don't worry too much. It will work out.
Then we'll head into the forest. Chief...
Oh, wait... Wh-what's this? Something feels strange in the village...
It certainly feels different outside the village.
So this is Crystal Moon Forest.
strings.마을 바깥이 보라색으로 물들어 있어서 직접 보고 싶다는 생각이 들었지만,: I wanted to see it for myself when I saw all that purple beyond the village, but it's even more beautiful than I imagined.
It's a forest full of good energy... Yet something feels odd.
strings.고대 시절부터 있던 엘프의 숲이 공원이 됐다는 사실이요. 마을이 발전하면: An elven forest that has existed since ancient times has become a park. I knew the forest had changed as the village developed, but... It feels strange.
And the fact that I'm here, too.
strings.그래야죠. 제가 언제 수정달 숲에 오겠어요. 제피 덕분이니까 이렇게 오지: I should try not to. When else would I get to visit Crystal Moon Forest? I'm only here thanks to Zephy.
strings.(클로리스의 자조적인 농담이 끝나자 옆으로 숲을 구경하려는 사람들이 지나: (As Chloris finishes her self-deprecating joke, people pass by on their way to see the forest.)
It seems a little early, but there are quite a few people out walking.
Yes. There are people across the lake too.
strings.(일반적인 관광객과는 다른 분위기를 지닌 일행이 호수 맞은 편에서 주위를: (A group with an air unlike ordinary tourists surveys the area on the opposite side of the lake.)
%s, I have a favor to ask.
strings.이 자리에서 아무 말 없이 선 채로 풍경을 눈에 담아두고 싶어요. 잠깐이: I'd like to stand here in silence and take in the scenery. Just for a moment.
Oh, I'd like that too. Let's enjoy the view together.
strings.(클로리스가 고개를 끄덕이고 고개를 돌려 수정달 숲의 풍경을 한참동안 바: (Chloris nods, then turns and gazes at Crystal Moon Forest for a long while.)
strings.후우, 끝. 이제 갈까요?: Whew. All done. Shall we go now?
According to the map, there's a cathedral this way.
strings.성당은 좀 머니까 마지막에 가볼까요. 그런데, %s 씨. 이 아이 알아요: The cathedral is a little far. Shall we leave it until last? Oh, %s. Do you know this child?
(Chloris points to a little girl tugging at %s's clothes.)
strings.엥, 언제부터 있었던 거야?: Huh? When did you get here?
strings.(어디선가 본 것 같은 투구를 쓴 여자아이가 방긋 웃는다.): (The girl, wearing a helmet that looks strangely familiar, smiles brightly.)
strings.자물쇠! 보고 싶었어!! 자물쇠는 나 안보고 싶었어?: Lock! I missed you!! Didn't you miss me?
strings.얘는 무슨 소리를 하는 거지…. 너 나 알아?: What is she talking about...? Do you know me?
It's my first time seeing you too, Lock! Hehe...
strings.얘, 네 이름을 말해줄래?: Little one, will you tell us your name?
strings.(자신을 모드레드라고 소개한 여자아이가 폴짝폴짝 뛰어오른다. 아무도 모드: (The girl who introduced herself as Mordred hops up and down. No one notices something fall from her clothes.)
strings.왜 나를 자물쇠라 불러?: Why do you call me Lock?
strings.우웅, 자물쇠가 아니면 뭐지? 열쇠?: Hmm. If you're not a lock, what are you? A key?
strings.(모드레드가 열쇠라고 하는 순간, 보랏빛으로 빛나던 수정달 숲이 어둠에: (The instant Mordred says 'key,' the violet glow of Crystal Moon Forest is engulfed in darkness. The forest begins shaking rapidly.)
strings.(클로리스가 마치 시간의 경계에 서 있는 것처럼 움직임이 멈춰있다. 하지: (Chloris stands motionless, as though at the boundary of time. Other beings slip into the gap and catch Mordred as she tries to move.)
...You. Why are you awake? Everything in this space has stopped. Why are you alone...?
strings.모드레드, 내가 옆에 있으라고 했죠?: Mordred, I told you to stay beside me, didn't I?
Sigh... We'll have to change the plan, Merlin.
strings.(멀린이라고 불린 남자가 고개를 끄덕이고, 모드레드를 어깨에 매단다. 그: (The man called Merlin nods and puts Mordred over his shoulder. The suspicious woman approaches %s, who is struggling with dizziness.)
strings.당신이 누군지 모르겠지만…. 당신은 우리를 기억하면 안 돼요. 그러니까: I don't know who you are... But you mustn't remember us. I'll make it as though you never saw us. This is for everyone's sake.
strings.(여성이 쥐고 있던 펜던트를 %s의 눈 앞에 가까이 댄다. 손등을 살짝: (The woman holds a pendant close to %s's eyes. As she tilts her hand, it slowly swings from side to side.)
Thoughts of the living. Return to the primordial air before you become memories...
strings.(여성의 말과 함께 펜던트 끝에서 짙은 그림자가 흘러나온다. 그리고 %s: (At the woman's words, a dense shadow flows from the pendant and swallows the light remaining around %s.)
The cathedral is a little far. Shall we leave it until last?
strings.우리가 여기서 숲의 풍경을 구경하고 있었던 거 맞죠?: We were looking at the forest scenery here, right?
strings.맞아요. 다른 생각이라도 하신 거예요?: Yes. Was your mind somewhere else?
strings.그런 건 아닌데…. 분명 여기에 뭐가 있었던 것 같아요. 어? 이거 뭐지: No, not exactly... I'm sure something was here. Huh? What's this?
strings.(%s의 발밑에 떨어져 있던 걸 클로리스가 주워 손에 든다.): (Chloris picks up something lying at %s's feet.)
There's a name on the envelope.
From your friend and brother, Notos... Zephy must have received Notos's letter.
strings.그러면 제피로스 님이 여기 있었다는 건데…. 어? 어!: Then Zephyros was here... Huh? Oh!
strings.런튼과 코렌이 제피로스 님을 기억하지 못했어요. 분명 아는 것 같은 분위: Lunton and Coren couldn't remember Zephyros. They seemed certain they knew him, but then said they couldn't remember.
strings.저 지금 분명 방금 전까지도 그걸 알아차리지 못했어요. 그리고 여기 어린: I hadn't even realized that until this moment. And there was a little girl here, wasn't there?
strings.(머릿속에서 알 수 없는 인물들의 모습이 떠오르더니 순식간에 사라진다.): (Images of unfamiliar figures arise in my mind, then vanish in an instant.)
strings.모드…레드? 모드레드라고 했어요. 아, 이제 알 거 같아요. 갑자기 나타: Mord... red? She said her name was Mordred. Ah, I think I remember. She appeared suddenly and called me a lock... a key...
And the helmet she was wearing was definitely Weiss's...
strings.침착하세요…. 혹시 무슨 일이 있었는지 다 기억하세요?: Stay calm... Do you remember everything that happened?
strings.네, 이제 기억이 떠오르는 것 같아요. 여자 아이를 찾으러 온 일행이 있: Yes, I think it's coming back. A group came looking for the girl...
strings.(클로리스에게 떠오르는 기억을 전부 다 이야기한다.): (I tell Chloris every memory that comes back to me.)
strings.이제 조금씩 맞춰지는 것 같네요. 펜던트를 가진 여자는 우리가 방금 자신: I think the pieces are beginning to fit. The woman with the pendant made us forget that we'd just met them.
Likewise, she made the villagers forget Zephyros.
strings.모드레드라는 아이가 이 편지를 떨어뜨린 게 일부러 그런건지 실수인지는 알: I don't know whether Mordred dropped this letter deliberately or by accident... But touching it allowed us to recall the hidden memories.
Thank goodness there was magic left in this letter...
We have to find those people quickly. Others could be in danger.
Yes. Shall we start over there? I sense powerful magic in that direction.
strings.(클로리스가 시선을 돌려 한쪽을 가리킨다. 그 순간, 숲 안쪽에서 불어오: (Chloris turns and points. At that moment, wind from deep in the forest approaches with an eerie chill.)
I think there's a group over there that won't be pleased to see us.
strings.(리프의 목소리가 수정달 숲에 울려퍼진다.): (Lif's voice rings throughout Crystal Moon Forest.)
strings.「여행객들은 서둘러 마을로 돌아와주세요!! 긴급 상황입니다!」: 「All visitors, return to the village immediately!! This is an emergency!」
strings.「다시 한 번 알립니다. 여행객들은 서둘러 마을로 돌아와주세요!! 숲지기: 「I repeat. All visitors, return to the village immediately!! Forest keepers, evacuate the visitors in the forest to the village at once.」
strings.(수정달 숲에 위험을 알리는 리프의 목소리가 울려퍼진다.): (Lif's voice echoes through Crystal Moon Forest, warning of danger.)
What's happened? For the director to make an announcement like this...
I heard she could carry her voice throughout the forest...
strings.(런튼의 말이 끝나기가 무섭게 보랏빛으로 가득했던 수정달 숲에 짙은 어둠: (Before Lunton finishes speaking, a deep darkness begins settling over the violet Crystal Moon Forest.)
strings.확실히 뭔가 이상한데. 런튼, 어서 가자!: Something is definitely wrong. Lunton, let's go!
You two, please take any visitors you see back with you.
strings.런튼, 너는 어떻게 하려고?: Lunton, what are you going to do?
Drive off those animals gathering over there.
strings.(숲지기들이 마력에 반응해 달려오는 동물들을 발견하고 놀란다. 그러자 런: (The forest keepers spot animals rushing toward them in response to the magic. Startled, they hesitate, and Lunton hurriedly pushes them forward.)
I'll drive off the animals and protect anyone who comes to this rest area.
strings.혼자로 괜찮겠어?: Will you be all right alone?
strings.동물들을 상대하는 건 제가 잘 하는 일입니다…. 어서 가세요!: Handling animals is what I do best... Go, quickly!
strings.(런튼의 말에 다른 숲지기들이 고개를 끄덕이고 서둘러 지름길을 향해 뛰어: (The other forest keepers nod and hurry toward the shortcut.)
strings.말은 했지만, 저 많은 하마마와 고슴이를 어떻게 쫓아내지…?: I said that, but how am I going to drive off so many Hamamas and hedgehogs...?
strings.(많은 동물들을 상대하면서 쫓고 있을 때, 런튼의 앞으로 두 사람이 나타: (As Lunton struggles to fend off the many animals, two people appear before him.)
strings.(가시나무의 줄기가 솟아오르고, 나뭇잎이 바람을 타고 동물들의 앞을 가로: (Thorny stems rise from the ground, and leaves ride the wind to block the animals' path. Some startled animals retreat.)
It's too dangerous to face this alone.
Don't worry about us. Let's drive away the animals first.
There are other ominous beings here besides the animals. %s, please handle those.
strings.네, 클로리스 씨! 런튼은 물러나요. 이제 우리가 할 테니까!: All right, Chloris! Lunton, stand back. We'll take over!
(Through the two's efforts, the animals and other beings threatening the people are driven away.)
Whew. We can catch our breath now.
strings.저는 괜찮습니다. 여러분 덕분에 숲에 계신 관광객분들이 마을로 돌아갈 수: I'm all right. Thanks to you, the visitors in the forest can return to the village.
strings.(클로리스가 런튼을 바라보자 마력으로 태어난 아름다운 꽃과 나무 줄기들이: (As Chloris looks at Lunton, the beautiful flowers and stems created by her magic disappear.)
strings.…아름다운 마법입니다. 이렇게 꽃과 나무, 바람 마법을 아름답게 다루는: ...What beautiful magic. I never knew someone could wield flower, tree, and wind magic so beautifully...
My skill is nothing to boast about. And this wasn't even my own power to begin with...
strings.클로리스 씨. 런튼에게 확인해야겠죠?: Chloris, we should check with Lunton, shouldn't we?
strings.그래야죠. 런튼, 제피로스를 기억하시나요?: Yes. Lunton, do you remember Zephyros?
strings.네, 기억…합니다. 리프 소장님께 그분을 찾아야 한다고 전해듣는 순간,: Yes, I... remember. The moment Director Lif told me we needed to find him, something felt strange.
It seems to have happened when we took hold of the letter.
strings.암막 커튼으로 가려진 제 기억이 빛을 받아 떠오른 순간이었습니다. 제가: It was as though light shone on memories hidden behind blackout curtains. I remembered guiding that male mage into the forest. His name was definitely Zephyros...
strings.그분이 이렇게 생기셨죠?: He looks like this, doesn't he?
strings.(런튼이 쪼그려앉아 떨어진 나뭇가지를 이용해 사람 얼굴을 그린다. 클로리: (Lunton crouches and uses a fallen twig to draw a face. Chloris looks at the drawing and bursts into laughter.)
A mage with long blue hair, glasses, and a thoroughly disgruntled expression...
strings.꺄하하하, 제피로스 맞아요. 너무 똑같이 그리셨다. 그래서 제피로스를 어: Ahahaha! That's Zephyros. You've captured him perfectly. So where did you take him?
strings.숲에 달의 정기가 강한 장소가 하나 있습니다. 리프 소장님의 허가 때만: There is a place in the forest where the moon's energy is especially strong. Access is restricted to those with Director Lif's permission. She granted it, so I took him there.
strings.그러고 보니 그곳에서 제 기억과 그분이 사라진 것 같습니다…. 그게 벌써: Come to think of it, I believe both he and my memories disappeared there... That was several days ago now...
strings.런튼, 그곳이 어딘지 알려주시겠어요? 지도엔 나와있지 않은 곳이죠?: Lunton, could you tell us where it is? It isn't on the map, is it?
strings.(런튼이 주머니에서 펜을 꺼내 %s의 손에 있던 지도에 X 자로 표시한다: (Lunton takes a pen from his pocket and marks an X on the map in %s's hand.)
No. Please follow Director Lif's instructions, Lunton.
strings.저는 수정달 숲의 숲지기입니다. 이곳의 일을 하는게 제 임무이자 사명이죠: I am a keeper of Crystal Moon Forest. Tending to this place is my duty and calling. Whatever has happened here...
strings.지금 런튼이 할 수 있는 최선의 일을 생각해봐요. 일반 엘프가 가봐야 할: Think about the best thing you can do now. There's nothing an ordinary elf could do by going there.
strings.(클로리스의 말에 런튼이 뭔가 깨달았는지 고개를 끄덕인다.): (Lunton seems to realize something at Chloris's words and nods.)
I'm sorry. I appreciate your wish to help. Or perhaps...
You can help us twice as much next time.
strings.원래 하프엘프는 도움을 받으면 두 배로 도와줘요. 그만큼 도움을 받을 수: Half-elves repay help twice over. We have so few chances to receive it...
strings.그런 하프엘프를 도와주겠다는 거잖아요. 그러니까 두 배로 도와야 뭔가 다: And you're offering to help a half-elf. So if you help twice as much, it'll make helping you next time more worthwhile, won't it?
strings.앞뒤가 하나도 안맞는 이상한 말이지만, 클로리스 씨가 말씀하시니 납득이: That logic makes no sense at all, but somehow, when you say it, Chloris, it almost does.
strings.(클로리스가 눈을 감은 채로 알 수 없는 말을 중얼거리고 있다.): (Chloris has her eyes closed and is murmuring unfamiliar words.)
I quickly prepared a spell. I don't know when we'll need it, but...
strings.혹시 몰라서요. 마을과 숲에 있는 사람들의 기억을 지운거라면 분명 보통: Just in case. Anyone who erased the memories of people throughout the village and forest is clearly no ordinary person...
strings.일단은요. 후우…. 그럼 이제 가실까요?: For now. Whew... Shall we go?
strings.(지도를 보고 도착한 수정달 숲의 안쪽. 유독 다른 곳보다 보랏빛이 진한: (Following the map deep into Crystal Moon Forest, we find a path through undergrowth of a deeper purple than anywhere else.)
strings.(수풀을 헤치고 어느 정도 들어갔을 때, 앞서 가던 클로리스의 발걸음이: (After pushing through the vegetation for a while, Chloris, who is leading, stops.)
strings.우리 지금 뒤틀린 시공간 속에 있어요. 관문 게이트에 있었던 것과는 조금: We're inside distorted spacetime. It's a little different from what was at the gateway.
It felt so natural that I only just noticed... Ah...
strings.여기는 누가 만든 걸까요…? 어떻게 나가야 하지? 흐음…. 아무리 봐도: Who made this place...? How do we get out? Hmm... It doesn't look like the Reverse Side...
Do you see it? Over there...
strings.(클로리스가 가리킨 곳에 방금 전까지 보이지 않던 벽이 세워져 있다.): (A wall that was invisible a moment ago stands where Chloris points.)
A glowing green wall... I've seen this wall before. It's...
strings.(벽을 향해 다가갔을 때, 뒤에서 낯설지 않은 사람 하나가 모습을 드러낸: (As we approach the wall, a familiar person appears from behind it.)
strings.(폐하께서 말씀하신 곧 나타날 마녀가 힐다인걸까…?): (Is Hilda the witch Her Majesty said would appear...?)
strings.내 이름, 기억하고 있어? 아, 이게 아니지. 네가 어째서 여기에 있는: You remember my name? No, that's not the point. Why are you here?
Why do you keep finding me...?
That's what I'd like to ask you.
strings.(힐다가 손을 뻗자 %s의 앞에 새로운 녹색 빛의 벽이 솟아오른다.): (Hilda reaches out, and a new wall of green light rises before %s.)
I'm dizzy. It's all because of you...
%s, who are you talking to? And this wall...
strings.클로리스 씨는 지금 앞에 있는 사람이 보이지 않나요?: Chloris, can't you see the person in front of us?
strings.소리만 들리고, 모습은 보이지 않았는데…. 이 앞에 있는 여자분은 대체…: I could only hear a voice, not see anyone... But this woman in front of us...
strings.(힘들어하던 힐다가 벽을 붙잡은 채로 고개를 들어 클로리스를 바라본다.): (Struggling, Hilda clings to the wall and raises her head to look at Chloris.)
Headmistress, please tell %s to step back.
%s, step back for now. Then we'll talk.
All right, Chloris. Hilda, I'll do as you ask.
strings.(어지러움을 호소하던 힐다가 그대로 주저앉는다.): (Still complaining of dizziness, Hilda sinks to the ground.)
Hilda, was it? You know me.
I saw you when I hid in the academy's main building for a little while...
strings.우리 선생님들과 직원들은 모두 실력있는 마법사예요. 그런 분들이 학교에: Our teachers and staff are all skilled mages. To think none of them noticed you hiding in the academy... Though I didn't notice either.
strings.힐다, 지금도 숨어있던 거였어요?: Hilda, were you hiding here too?
strings.말할 수 없어, 미안…. 그냥 조용히 나가줘…. 뒤로 계속 걷다보면 다시: I can't tell you. I'm sorry... Please just leave quietly... Keep walking backward, and you'll get out again. So please...
strings.힐다가 계속 여기 숨어 있고, 우리가 계속 사람을 찾는다면 또 보게 될: If you keep hiding here, and we keep searching for someone, we'll run into you again.
strings.강력한 마력이 나타났다 사라졌는데, 그게 이사장이었나? 사실 그게 누군지: A powerful magic appeared and disappeared. Was that the chairman? I didn't actually know who it was... Could it be...?
I think another witch took him. But why...?
strings.(힐다의 말이 끝나기도 전에 초록색 벽을 비롯한 보이는 모든 것이 왜곡된: (Before Hilda finishes, the green walls and everything else in sight begin shaking as though distorted.)
strings.(시야에 보이는 모든 것이 마치 유리가 깨진 것처럼 천천히 갈라진다. 그: (Everything in view slowly fractures like breaking glass. Even Hilda at its center.)
strings.기억은 시간의 나열…. 지금 이곳으로 들어오려는 건 기억의 마녀…. 아마: Memories are time arranged in sequence... The one trying to enter now is the Witch of Memory... She probably needed someone who holds the power of time.
That's all I can tell you. Goodbye now.
strings.%s, 나는 살아야 해, 마녀의 손에 죽을 수 없어!!: %s, I have to live. I can't die at a witch's hands!!
strings.(힐다가 안쪽에 세워진 초록색 벽을 향해 뛰어간다. 그렇게 문은 그대로: (Hilda runs toward the green wall farther inside. It takes her in, then vanishes from the spot.)
strings.(힐다가 사라지자마자 흔들리고 갈라지던 풍경 사이로 가려져 있던 누군가의: (The instant Hilda disappears, someone's hidden figure slowly emerges through the shaking, fractured scenery.)
strings.(여성 주위에 그림자가 나타났다 사라지기를 반복한다. 여성은 개의치 않는: (Shadows flicker in and out around the woman. Unconcerned, she keeps toying with the pendant in her hand.)
I thought the cat I was looking for was inside the box, but it seems to have escaped...
strings.의미 없이 죽는 것보다 사라지는 게 좋은 선택이예요. 칭찬하고 싶을 정도: Disappearing is a better choice than dying for nothing. Almost worthy of praise...
strings.(알 수 없는 말을 중얼거리던 여성과 %s의 눈이 마주친다.): (Still murmuring cryptically, the woman meets %s's eyes.)
strings.당신은 나를 막으러 온 건가요?: Have you come to stop me?
strings.당신이 아서를 막고 아즈라엘에 가지 못하게 했던 것처럼 날 막을 거냐고: I'm asking whether you'll stop me as you stopped Arthur from reaching Azrael.
Arthur is another name I use for him...
strings.열쇠가 되지 못한 당신을 원망하지 않아요. 아서의 방법이 아니라도 다른: I don't resent you for failing to become a key. There are plenty of other methods besides Arthur's...
Yes. My Arthur is the Weiss you know, who has already vanished from this world.
But why can you move? You should be frozen, like that woman...
strings.(수상한 여성이 가리키는 쪽을 바라보자 클로리스가 손을 뻗은 상태에서 멈: (Looking where the suspicious woman points, I find Chloris frozen with her hand outstretched.)
My body won't move... This is... Ugh...
strings.(클로리스가 고통스러워하는 표정으로 입을 겨우 연다.): (Chloris barely manages to open her mouth, her face twisted in pain.)
strings.엘프 마법사께서 이 일그러진 시공간에서 얼마나 버틸 수 있을지 모르겠네요: I wonder how long an elven mage can endure this distorted spacetime...
strings.아니에요. 그저 여러 세계의 시간과 공간의 일부를 쪼개서 이곳에 덧씌웠죠: No. I merely broke off fragments of time and space from various worlds and overlaid them here. The moment something that should not be here exists...
Here I am explaining something I needn't explain.
strings.모드레드가 쓸데없는 짓만 하지 않았어도 벌써 다 끝났을 텐데…. 정말 피: If Mordred hadn't done something so useless, everything would already be finished... How exhausting.
strings.복잡하게 이야기하고 싶지 않으니까 돌아가요. 모든 걸 잊어요. 내가 다: I don't want a complicated discussion. Go back. Forget everything. I'll make you forget it all. That would be better for you.
You have no other choice anyway.
strings.(무표정이던 여성이 무기를 쥐고 있던 %s의 손에 힘이 들어가자 가볍게: (The previously expressionless woman smiles faintly as %s tightens their grip on their weapon.)
strings.(검은 옷 차림의 남성이 여성의 이름을 부르며 나타난다.): (A man dressed in black appears, calling the woman's name.)
strings.(모르가나가 한숨을 내쉬고 쥐고 있던 펜던트를 흔든다. 그러자 멈춰있던: (Morgana sighs and swings the pendant in her hand. Chloris, freed from her frozen state, loses her strength and sinks to the ground.)
Cough, cough. I'm all right. Ugh... Please help me up.
strings.(두 사람의 모습을 바라보던 모르가나가 조용히 뒤로 물러난다.): (Watching the two, Morgana quietly steps back.)
That woman is a half-blood too...
They are, but there is still a little time before the song of the star begins.
strings.(멀린의 답을 들은 모르가나가 만족한 것 같은 엷은 미소를 짓는다. 그리: (A faint, satisfied smile crosses Morgana's face at Merlin's answer. She speaks quietly to him.)
strings.(멀린이 피식 웃으며 모르가나의 앞으로 걸어나간다. 잠시 후, 고개를 숙: (Merlin gives a faint laugh and steps in front of Morgana. He lowers his head, and something dark red grows from his back.)
strings.(멀린의 검붉은 날개가 모르가나를 감싸자마자 그를 비롯한 주위에 있던 모: (The instant Merlin's dark red wings wrap around Morgana, he and everything around him vanish as though evaporating.)
strings.(주위에 머물렀던 수상한 그림자도 사라져 원래대로 깨끗한 보랏빛 숲으로: (The strange shadows disappear as well, and the forest returns to its clear violet color.)
They seem to be preparing something.
strings.일시적이라서 금방 괜찮아졌어요…. 이런 기분을 또 느끼게 될 줄이야. 윈: It was temporary, so I recovered quickly... I never thought I'd feel that again. Merging with the Windy Seed was unpleasant enough...
strings.모르가나라는 이름, 학생들에게서 들은 적이 있어요. 나쁜 기억으로 힘들어: I've heard the name Morgana from the students. They say she comforts and heals people troubled by painful memories.
If this is her kind of healing, I'll pass. Erasing or distorting memories... I've already had one memory erased before.
strings.그건 그렇고, 모르가나가 바이스를 언급했던데…. 혹시 이스트랜드에 계실: Anyway, Morgana mentioned Weiss... Did you ever see her while you were in Eastland?
No, I never saw her. But I think she really was with Weiss.
strings.모르가나와 함께 있던 여자 아이가 바이스가 쓰던 투구랑 똑같은 걸 쓰고: The little girl with Morgana was wearing a helmet identical to his. A smaller version, apparently...
strings.힐다라는 사람이 도망가면서 마녀에게 죽을 수 없다고 한 걸 보면 모르가나: Since Hilda said she couldn't die at a witch's hands as she fled, Morgana must be a witch, right? And Hilda herself too...
Her Majesty said a witch would appear soon, and...
strings.학원제 사고로 치료받으러 잠깐 글래스턴에 있다가 돌아왔을 때, 학원장실에: After the academy festival accident, I stayed in Glaston briefly for treatment. When I returned, someone was waiting in the headmistress's office.
strings.아까 제가 이야기했었죠? 지워진 기억이 하나 있다고…. 그건 바로 마녀: I mentioned it earlier, didn't I? That I had a memory erased... It was the witch Daphne...
strings.(클로리스가 말을 이어가려는 순간, 멀리서 다급하게 달려오는 런튼의 모습: (As Chloris is about to continue, Lunton appears, running urgently toward us.)
strings.별일 없어 보여서 다행입니다. 숲을 나가지 않은 사람이 있나 다시 수색중: I'm glad you seem unharmed. I was searching again for anyone who hadn't left the forest, when someone I knew appeared...
strings.검은 머리에 파랑색과 붉은색 오드아이 엘프를 말하는 거죠?: An elf with black hair and one blue eye and one red eye, right?
Did you see him? He grew up with me when we were children... That is...
strings.(런튼이 식은 땀을 흘리며 괴로워한다.): (Lunton breaks into a cold sweat and looks distressed.)
strings.이름이 기억나질 않습니다. 이름이…. 그의 이름은, 그러니까…. 그리고: I can't remember his name. His name... It was... And how we played together... How he lived in the village...
I know him. I'm certain... Why can't I remember...?
Don't force yourself to remember, Lunton.
It seems Morgana has done it again.
strings.모르가나가 마을 사람들의 기억에서 제피로스 말고도 그 남자와 관련된 것도: It looks as though Morgana erased or distorted the villagers' memories of that man as well as Zephyros.
The memories of the whole village...
Chloris, I think we should go back and check.
You look unwell. You should go back and rest for now.
But I have work to do...
...The other forest keepers and Director Lif would want you to return too.
strings.여기서 심신을 안정시키는 마법이라도 써드릴까요? 그러면 런튼이 제게 도움: Shall I cast a spell here to calm your body and mind? Then you would owe me four times the help, rather than twice...
(Seemingly accepting Chloris's words, Lunton quietly nods and turns.)
...It seems all the visitors and villagers have returned...
Lunton, go home and rest for now. We'll speak to Director Lif.
strings.그러면 여덟 배로 할까요?: Shall we make it eight times, then?
strings.(런튼이 체념한 듯 가볍게 목례를 하고 집으로 보이는 건물 안으로 들어간: (Lunton gives a small, resigned bow and enters what appears to be his home.)
It's a method I developed while teaching students. Boys in particular.
Then let's check on the people in the village before visiting the director.
strings.기분 좋게 쉬려고 하는데, 시끄럽네. 도크알프 사제들이 여기는 왜 온 거: I was hoping to relax, but it's so noisy. Why have Dokkalf priests come here?
strings.(숲지기들이 대피시킨 사람들을 바라보던 라슈르가 가볍게 기지개를 켠다.): (Watching the people evacuated by the forest keepers, Lashur stretches lightly.)
I don't know what's happening, but it doesn't look profitable.
strings.(그러던 중, 다가오는 모험가와 눈이 마주친다.): (Then he meets the approaching adventurer's eyes.)
strings.오, %s 하고 클로리스 학원장. 일은 끝났어?: Oh, %s and Headmistress Chloris. Finished your business?
It looks like nothing has happened to you, Lashur.
I've secured a distribution agreement for Lifthrasir's fine goods on excellent terms. Hahaha!
strings.(라슈르가 여유있는 미소를 지으며 머리를 쓸어넘긴다. 이런 라슈르가 익숙: (Lashur smiles comfortably and brushes back his hair. Apparently accustomed to this, Chloris applauds without much enthusiasm.)
strings.라슈르 씨, 혹시 마을에 계시는 동안 이상한 점을 느끼시지 못했나요?: Lashur, have you noticed anything strange during your stay in the village?
strings.글쎄? 신중해보이던 리프 촌장이 급하다면서 계약을 빨리 끝내려 하는거랑: Let's see. Chief Lif, who seemed so cautious, suddenly wanted to finish the contract in a hurry. And a whole crowd of Dokkalf priests arrived?
strings.아무래도 지금 마을 밖에 일어난 일 때문에 그런 거야?: Is it because of whatever's happening outside the village?
strings.학원장이 그렇다면 그런 거겠지. 하하하. 뭐, 괜찮아지겠지. 좀 쉬다가: If you say so, Headmistress. Hahaha. Well, I'm sure it'll work out. I'll rest a bit and return tomorrow.
Stay too long after achieving your purpose, and even the scent of future money fades away.
Hehe. Well, good luck. Let's meet again when there's a big opportunity.
I wonder when we'll see him again... Hmm...
strings.(코렌이 마을 이곳저곳을 뛰어다니며 불편함을 호소하는 관광객들의 민원을: (Coren runs about the village, handling complaints from inconvenienced visitors. Eventually, he seems to finish and catches his breath.)
Whew... I can rest a little now.
strings.하마마랑 고슴이가 예민해진데다가 못보던 동물들이 나타난 건 무슨 일이지?: The Hamamas and hedgehogs are agitated, and animals I've never seen before have appeared. What's happening?
I hope the forest keepers are all right...
strings.(코렌이 자신도 모르게 뒷걸음질 치려는 걸 깨닫고 발걸음을 멈춘다.): (Coren realizes he is unconsciously starting to back away and stops himself.)
It's all right. You didn't run away this time.
strings.좋게 봐줘서 고마워. 그런데 두 사람, 별 일 없었어?: Thanks for being kind about it. Are you two all right?
Thank goodness. Some of the visitors came back frightened, so I was worried.
strings.아하하…. 아, 코렌. 검은 머리에 파랗고 빨간 오드아이 엘프를 알아요?: Ahaha... Oh, Coren. Do you know an elf with black hair, one blue eye, and one red eye?
strings.어? 클로리스 누나하고 넌 그 사람 알아? 나는 사람들이 이야기해서 그냥: Huh? Do you and Chloris know him? I only know a little about what happened from people's stories.
strings.이상하다…. 아까 전엔 누나가 말한 안경낀 마법사를 본게 떠올랐거든. 그: That's strange... Earlier, I remembered seeing the mage with glasses she described. But now I can't remember the story I knew.
Yes. Lunton showed him around the forest.
It's all right. Losing your memories isn't your fault.
strings.리프 소장님께 가기 전에 잠깐 정리할까요?: Shall we review what we know before visiting Director Lif?
strings.일단 라슈르 씨를 비롯해서 외부 사람들 몇 명, 런튼과 코렌 같은 리프트: We've heard from a few outsiders, including Lashur, and Lifthrasir residents like Lunton and Coren...
strings.확실히 외지인들에겐 별 일이 없어요. 다만, 마을 엘프들에게만 그 남자의: The outsiders are clearly unaffected. Only the village elves can't remember that man's name or what happened here.
Their memories of Zephyros have returned. That must be thanks to the letter.
strings.그리고 멀린이라고 했던 그 남자가 모르가나에게 준비가 됐다고 한 걸 보면: And since the man called Merlin told Morgana the preparations were complete, they're certainly planning something suspicious involving the village.
strings.클로리스 씨, 그런데 말이죠. 갑자기 도크알프 사제단이 도착했다는데, 뭘: Chloris, what about the Dokkalf priests who suddenly arrived?
strings.엘프 사제들은 좀처럼 움직이지 않아요. 게다가 도크엘프, 그것도 수십 명: Elven priests rarely travel. Dozens of Dokkalf priests, especially, would only move at the summons of a high-ranking being.
strings.높은 존재의 부름…. 어, 클로리스 씨?: A high-ranking being's summons... Oh, Chloris?
strings.(클로리스의 시선이 머무는 곳에 바쁘게 몰려드는 사람들의 질문을 받는 리: (Where Chloris is looking, Lif is busy answering questions from a crowd.)
The director must know what that man is planning.
strings.(관광객들이 돌아가고 한숨 돌리던 리프가 두 사람이 다가오는 걸 보고 놀: (After the tourists leave, Lif catches her breath, then looks surprised to see the two approaching.)
Are you both all right? I was worried because I couldn't find you.
strings.저희는 괜찮아요. 다른 관광객들은 괜찮은 건가요?: We're fine. Are the other visitors all right?
strings.리프 소장님께 여쭤볼 게 있어요. 소장님은 이미 알고 계셨죠?: Director Lif, I have something to ask. You already knew, didn't you?
I'm not sure what you mean...
strings.%s 씨와 제가 숲으로 갔을 때, 무슨 일이 일어났던 걸…. 그리고 다른: What happened when %s and I went into the forest... And that something else would happen too.
The Dokkalf priests' sudden arrival in the village is strange as well.
Please tell us why those priests, who so rarely travel, have come.
strings.사제들이 업무 협약이라고 말은 했지만, 분명 따로 지시받은 게 있을 거예: They said it was a cooperation agreement, but they must have separate orders. So please tell us.
About the man traveling with the witch.
I wanted to resolve this quietly...
strings.리프트라시르 주민들에게서 제피로스가 나타났던 기억이 모두 사라졌지만, 리: Every Lifthrasir resident lost their memories of Zephyros's arrival. Yet you alone remembered his name and what he intended to do.
strings.기억을 다루는 마녀는 아마 소장님의 힘을 전부 파악하지 못했겠죠. 이제: The witch who manipulates memories probably didn't fully grasp your power. Please tell us now. What happened to Zephyros...?
strings.저도 정말 늦게 깨달았어요. 제가 숲과 마을에서 일어나는 일을 모를리 없: I realized it very late myself. I should know everything that happens in the forest and village. Yet this power was so strong that even I couldn't recognize it.
He wants revenge on this village. I intended to stop him myself...
strings.도와드릴게요. 저는 그 사람을 찾아야 하고, 리프 소장님은 마을을 구해야: We'll help. I need to find him, and you need to save the village.
Tell us, Director Lif. That man is with a witch now.
strings.(리프가 마녀라는 말에 입술을 살짝 깨문다.): (Lif bites her lip at the word witch.)
I'll tell you. Though I'm not sure where to begin...
That child's name is Saleon. He lived in Lifthrasir with his mother.
strings.10년 전, 제국에서 선대 황제가 갑자기 타계했을 때…. 마녀 때문이란: Ten years ago, when the Empire's previous ruler died suddenly, rumors spread that a witch was responsible. As though to quell those rumors, the council's nobles began searching for a witch.
If there was no witch, they would look for demons or Agasura instead.
strings.엘프들이 사는 알프헤임은 별 문제 없을 줄 알았는데, 마을 사람 하나가: I thought Alfheim, home to the elves, would be unaffected. But one villager reported that Saleon was an elf born through the power of a dream demon.
So that's why he called me a half-blood...
strings.엘프에게 약간의 폐쇄성이 있긴 하지만, 그래도 오랫동안 마을에서 함께 지: Elves can be rather insular, but I believed they wouldn't cast out neighbors who'd lived among them for so long. I was mistaken.
strings.제보한 사람이 다른 주민에게 소문을 냈고, 주민들은 동요했어요. 그리고: The informant spread rumors to the others, and the villagers grew agitated. They even turned on me when I tried to protect the pair.
strings.일단 두 사람을 멀리 보내려고 하던 밤, 제국 마법청 소속의 마법사가 나: The night I planned to send them somewhere far away, a mage from the imperial Magic Bureau appeared. Claiming to have found demons, he abducted them and dragged them into the forest.
But demons were not what the mage wanted.
strings.(여기서도 마법청이….): (The Magic Bureau was involved here too...)
strings.살레온이 가진 힘…. 마법사가 가지고 있던 포션이 그동안 그 아이에게서: He wanted Saleon's power... A potion the mage carried made wings grow from the boy, wings none of us had ever seen...
Then the mage cast a spell that amplified Saleon's power.
strings.마을 사람들은 다른 모습의 살레온에게 겁을 먹었고, 악마라며 횃불을 던졌: Frightened by his changed appearance, the villagers called him a devil and threw torches. Saleon panicked and flailed his arms, injuring one of them.
strings.그 모습을 본 마법사가 살레온이 사악한 악마, 마족의 후예라면서 불길을: Seeing that, the mage called Saleon an evil devil, a descendant of demons, and conjured flames. At that moment, his mother Maria threw herself in front of him. To protect her son...
strings.마리아가 마법사의 마법을 그대로 맞아 온 몸에 불이 붙었고, 그 모습을: Maria took the full force of the mage's spell, and her entire body caught fire. The sight shocked Saleon into unconsciousness...
strings.다시 눈을 뜨자마자 악마로 변해 폭주하면서 마법사를 죽였어요…. 그 과정: When he opened his eyes again, he transformed into a devil, went berserk, and killed the mage... In the process, half of Crystal Moon Forest and the village burned down.
Even I, who had lived with the forest for so long, could not stop it.
strings.그렇게 살레온은 저에게는 미안하다는 말을, 자신을 몰아세운 이들에겐 저주: Saleon apologized to me, cursed those who had hounded him, and left. That was already ten years ago...
strings.마을과 숲이 반이나 불에 탔다는데, 지금 모습을 보면 그런 게 전혀 떠오: Half the village and forest burned down? You'd never know it from looking at them now.
strings.저는 리프트라시르의 촌장이니까요. 살레온이 떠나고 엉망이 된 마을을 저는: I am Lifthrasir's chief. After Saleon left, I had to restore the ruined village somehow. The lives and land that the hero had saved...
strings.알프헤임의 모든 엘프들이 돈독이 올랐다며 저를 욕해도 상관없었어요. 용사: I didn't care if every elf in Alfheim cursed me as money-mad. If selling the hero's legend would let their descendants live well, so be it.
You have nothing to apologize for, Director Lif.
strings.리프트라시르의 일 때문에 혼혈에 대한 소문이 더 안 좋게 퍼졌잖아요. 수: What happened in Lifthrasir made the rumors about mixed-blood people even worse. The last ten years have been worse than the centuries before them.
The fault lies with the people who looked at those like me with hatred.
strings.시간이 지나면 자연스럽게 해결될 줄 알았는데. 역시 제대로 풀지 않으면: I thought time would resolve it naturally. But unless you truly address something, it remains a painful memory and returns...
strings.보름 전, 광장에서 비명소리가 들려와서 달려가니까 살레온이 나타나 사람을: A fortnight ago, I heard screams from the square and ran over. Saleon had appeared and killed someone...
strings.살레온의 정체를 제보하다 뜻대로 안되니까 마을 사람들에게 소문내고, 그를: The one who reported Saleon's identity, then spread rumors when things didn't go his way, and threw a torch at him...
strings.누구보다 리프트라시르가 커지는 걸 반대했던 사람이지만, 나중에 마을의 어: He opposed Lifthrasir's growth more fiercely than anyone. Yet later, he amassed more wealth than anyone in the village.
strings.그런 사람이 살레온에게 했던 그대로 살해당했어요. 불에 그을린 채로, 심: Saleon killed him in the same way he'd treated the boy. Burned and pierced through the heart...
strings.저는 이 사고가 더 커지지 않게, 더 피해자가 생기지 않게 사람들을 대피: I had to evacuate everyone before the incident grew worse and more people were hurt. We couldn't repeat what happened ten years ago...
strings.그러다 한 명이 살레온에게 붙잡혔어요. 그 사람도 죽은 사람과 함께 살레: Then Saleon caught another person. That one had tormented him alongside the dead man...
strings.마침, 숲에 갔었던 제피로스 씨가 돌아와 살레온에게 붙잡힌 그 사람을 구: Just then, Zephyros returned from the forest and rescued the person Saleon had seized.
strings.제피로스 씨가 저보고 그 사람을 데리고 가라고 하던 순간, 악마 꼬리를: As Zephyros told me to take that person away, a little child with a devil's tail and a woman holding a pendant appeared.
The woman with the pendant is a witch. From another world...
I see. The moment that witch raised her hand and released a strange power from the pendant...
strings.전 집으로 돌아와 있었어요. 아무런 일도 일어나지 않은 것처럼, 그 상황: I was back at home. As though nothing had happened, with no memory of the incident...
strings.마을 주민 뿐만 아니라, 잠시동안 이곳에 머물렀던 손님들도 기억하지 못했: Not only the villagers, but even the guests who had stayed here briefly could no longer remember it.
strings.다시 기억이 돌아왔을 때, 알게 됐어요. 살레온이 죽인 사람, 죽이려고: When my memories returned, I realized it. Even the existence of the two people Saleon had killed and tried to kill had vanished from everyone's memories...
Along with their memories of seeing Zephyros...
strings.모르가나란 마녀가 저와 클로리스 씨에게도 모드레드란 꼬마를 만났던 기억을: The witch Morgana erased my and Chloris's memories of meeting a little girl named Mordred too. And...
strings.(리프에게 힐다를 제외하고 숲에서 모르가나와 멀린을 만났던 일을 간단하게: (I briefly tell Lif about meeting Morgana and Merlin in the forest, leaving out Hilda.)
strings.모르가나란 마녀의 능력이 상상을 뛰어 넘는군요. 다른 세계에서 왔다더니…: This witch Morgana's abilities go beyond imagination. So she really is from another world...
I summoned them urgently, to stop the witch and Saleon...
strings.불멸의 사제단은 어둠의 힘과 의지를 믿는 수도사들인데, 마녀가 진리를 어: The Immortal Priesthood are monks who believe in the power and will of darkness. They have pursued witches for a long time, believing the witches defy the truth.
strings.마법청과 연결됐다는 이야기가 있지만, 지금은 그런걸 따질 때가 아니라서요: There are stories that they're connected to the Magic Bureau, but now is not the time to question that.
strings.리프 소장님, 클로리스 씨 말씀 들어보니 그런 집단은 쉽게 움직이지 않는: Director Lif, Chloris said groups like that don't act easily...
strings.소장님께서 대단하신 분이란 건 짐작할 수 있지만, 사제단을 움직일 정도면: I can tell you're someone remarkable, Director. But to mobilize a priesthood...
That isn't what's important now... No, I'll explain. This is the hero's authority.
strings.고대시절부터 리프트라시르의 촌장은 용사님의 권한을 위임받아 엘프 교단인: Since ancient times, Lifthrasir's chief has been entrusted with the hero's authority. We may make any request of any group belonging to any religious order, including the elven order of Hodmis.
strings.단, 교단에서 납득 가능한 것이라면 바로 처리되곤 해요. 이런 걸 요청한: Provided the order finds the request reasonable, it is usually handled immediately. This is my first time making such a request, so it feels a little strange.
strings.(단순히 교단에서 용사의 권한을 받은 마을 촌장의 요청을 받는 것 뿐일까: (Is it simply an order accepting a request from a village chief who holds the hero's authority? I feel there's more to it...)
strings.도크알프 출신의 사제들에게 맡겼으니 괜찮을 거예요. 제피로스 씨에 대한: I've left it to priests from Dokkalf, so it should be all right. I also asked them to ensure Zephyros's safety...
Still, I'm keeping watch, just in case. Oh, right...
strings.살짝 문제가 있어요. 도크알프 출신의 사제들은 엘프가 아닌 사람은 적대시: There is a small problem. Dokkalf priests tend to be hostile toward non-elves. Please be careful if you meet them.
...And %s... They didn't seem particularly fond of you.
strings.일이 커지는 게 싫은 것 같아 보이네요. 미움 받는게 한두 번은 아니지만: They seem to dislike things getting complicated. I'm used to being disliked, but it still stings a little. Ahaha...
strings.살레온…. 아니, 이제 멀린이 된 그 아이는 이곳에 복수하려고 온 거예요: Saleon... No, the boy who is now Merlin came here for revenge.
strings.그리고 마녀는 그런 살레온을 이용하겠죠. 분명 마녀는 우리의 중요한 걸: And the witch will use him. She must be after something important to us.
But the hero died long ago.
Some of the hero's power remains in Lifthrasir.
His power is divided between Twilight Cathedral and the Song of the Vanished Star.
strings.사라진 별의 노래?: The Song of the Vanished Star?
...A place where his remaining power was buried to keep demons from taking it.
strings.겉으로 보기엔 전설 속 용사를 기리기 위해 만든 커다란 별 모양 장식으로: From the outside, it looks like a giant star-shaped ornament honoring the legendary hero. But there's a special way to enter it.
strings.아…. 멀린이 준비가 끝났다고 말했을 때, 별의 노래가 시작될 시간이 남: Ah... When Merlin said his preparations were complete, he mentioned there was still time before the song of the star began.
He learned how to enter the Song of the Star from my memories...
strings.이제 곧 별의 노래가 열릴 시간이에요. 어서 가야 해요…. 그의 힘을 지: It will open soon. We must hurry... We have to protect his power.
strings.(리프가 패닉에 빠진 채로 가려는 걸 클로리스가 붙잡는다.): (As Lif tries to rush off in a panic, Chloris stops her.)
strings.리프 소장님은 마을 사람들과 함께 계세요. 저와 클로리스 씨가 그곳으로: Stay with the villagers, Director. Chloris and I will go there.
strings.리프 소장님, %s 씨 말대로 하세요. 지금 이상태로 가면 아무것도 할: Do as %s says. In your current state, you won't be able to do anything.
strings.(리프가 결심한 듯 고개를 끄덕인다. 그리고 클로리스와 %s의 손을 잡는: (Lif nods as though making up her mind, then takes Chloris's and %s's hands.)
strings.멀린이 그 안에 들어갔어요…. 하지만, 그의 힘이 있는 곳을 찾긴 쉽지: Merlin has gone inside... But he won't easily find where the hero's power lies.
strings.이제 두분은 그 안으로 들어갈 수 있어요. 멀린보다 빨리 갈 수 있도록: Now both of you can enter. I've made it possible for you to reach it before Merlin...
strings.아무것도 묻지 마시고, 그 안에서 멀린을 막아주세요. 그동안은 멀린과 마: Please don't ask anything. Stop him inside. While he's there, neither he nor the witch will be able to harm Lifthrasir...
I'm sorry to entrust our village's troubles to you...
It's all right. We'll be back soon.
strings.클로리스 씨, 지도에 거기 표시되어 있죠?: Chloris, is the place marked on the map?
We'll be there quickly if we take this path.
strings.(몽마의 힘을 가진 멀린과 상대하려면 제대로 준비하고 가야겠어.….): (I'll need to prepare properly to face Merlin and his dream-demon power...)
strings.(사람들이 모두 떠난 한적한 수정달 숲의 막다른 길목, 커다란 별 모양의: (At a quiet dead end in Crystal Moon Forest, deserted now, a huge star-shaped structure stands atop a small stone stairway.)
This must be the place Director Lif described.
I can feel tremendous magic within it.
strings.(모험가가 구조물 사이로 손을 뻗자 앞에 펼쳐져 있던 금빛의 얇은 막이: (The adventurer reaches between the parts of the structure, and a thin golden barrier stretched before them glimmers.)
It looks like we can go inside.
So it was true. The stories about people entering this...
strings.(별 모양 구조물 뒤에서 한 여성 엘프가 고개를 빼곰하고 내민다.): (A female elf peeks out from behind the star-shaped structure.)
I'm from Lifthrasir, but I don't live here now.
strings.왜 여기 혼자 있어요? 아까 리프 소장님이 숲에 있는 사람들에게 돌아오라: Why are you out here alone? Director Lif told everyone in the forest to return...
strings.영감이 잘 안 떠올라서 걷고 또 걷다 보니까 여기였어. 사라진 별의 노래: I couldn't find inspiration, so I kept walking and ended up here. The Song of the Vanished Star...
strings.용사를 별에 빗대고, 세상을 떠난 걸 사라진 노래라고 표현한 거 너무 좋: I love how it compares the hero to a star, and describes his passing as a song that vanished...
strings.내가 집중할 땐 리프 촌장님 목소리도 잘 못 들을 정도라…. 촌장님 또: When I'm concentrating, I barely hear Chief Lif's voice... She's going to lecture me again...
I write about all sorts of things... I'll head back soon.
strings.그런데 당신들, 누구야…? 다 돌아갔는데, 둘만 여기 와서 안으로 들어간: But who are you two...? Everyone else has left, and here you are talking about going inside. I can tell Chief Lif sent you, but...
strings.클로리스 씨, 어떻게 할까요? 클라라 씨에게 이야기해줘야 할 것 같은데…: Chloris, what should we do? I think we should explain to Clara...
Clara, I'm a mage named Chloris.
Ah... I think I've heard your name. I've read your book too.
No, not that. In the romance section of Belpa Library...
It was so much fun. What was the title again...? Hmm.
Aaaaah! Don't think about it, Clara.
strings.(클로리스가 당황한 표정으로 손을 뻗어 흔든다.): (Flustered, Chloris holds out her hands and waves them.)
All right... Then tell me what's important...
strings.어디까지 기억하고 있는지 모르겠지만, 10년 전에 마을을 떠났던 사람이: I don't know how much you remember, but someone who left the village ten years ago has returned...
strings.어쩐지 낯이 익더라…. 그때는 고마웠다, 이러면서 지나쳐서 누군가 했었는: No wonder he looked familiar... He passed me and said, 'Thank you for back then.' I was wondering who he was...
strings.기억? 아, 응…. 별로 좋은 일은 아니었지만…. 무슨 일이었지? 분명: Remember? Ah, yes... It wasn't a pleasant affair... What happened? His name was... It was...
So that's what you meant by not remembering. All right, I'll go back.
strings.혼자 가는 거 위험한데, 괜찮겠어요?: It's dangerous to go alone. Will you be all right?
strings.(%s의 질문이 끝나자 마자 수정달 숲에 다시 한 번 리프의 목소리가 울: (Before %s finishes asking, Lif's voice rings through Crystal Moon Forest once more.)
strings.「 클라라는 거기서 기다려!! 런튼이 갈 거야!」: 「Clara, wait right there!! Lunton is coming!」
I'd be fine on my own... But if Lunton is coming, it'll be all right.
Then stay here and make sure you go back with him.
strings.(모험가와 클로리스가 천천히 커다란 별 구조물 사이에 발을 내딛자 금색의: (As the adventurer and Chloris slowly step between the parts of the enormous star, the golden barrier glimmers again.)
strings.(잠시 후, 두 사람은 금색의 막 사이에 덮여 천천히 모습이 사라진다.): (Soon the two are enveloped by the golden veil and gradually disappear.)
So it really exists... The mysterious space the legendary hero once entered...
strings.(시야를 괴롭힐 정도로 다양한 색의 빛이 다가와 사라질 때쯤, 그제야 제: (When the dazzling, many-colored lights finally fade, the space that had been impossible to see becomes clear.)
strings.(반지모양으로 불타는 것 같은 달 밑으로, 별과 달 모양의 조각같은 것: (Beneath a moon that seems to burn like a ring, fragments shaped like stars and moons lie scattered on the ground.)
The Song of the Vanished Star...
strings.사람들이 알고 있는 아름다운 별과 달의 형상들이 전부 여기 있는 것 같아: It feels like every beautiful form of the stars and moon that people know is here...
strings.(클로리스가 가리킨 작은 언덕 위에 검은 늑대를 닮은 한 남자가 서 있다: (A man resembling a black wolf stands on the small hill Chloris points toward.)
strings.(멀린이 그자리에서 점프해 그대로 클로리스와 %s 앞으로 착지한다.): (Merlin leaps down and lands directly in front of Chloris and %s.)
It's been a long time since I heard that name. I abandoned it long ago.
Chief Lif must have told you.
I came to tell you that you are not the targets of my revenge.
strings.리프트라시르와 관계없는 자들은 돌아가라. 그렇지 않으면 아무 일도 없을: Those unconnected to Lifthrasir should go back. Nothing need happen to you.
strings.(오르카리움에서도 엘-라르사가 아무 일도 없던 것처럼 돌아가라고 했었는데: (In Orcarium, El-Larsa also told me to go back as though nothing had happened...)
strings.사람을 죽인 자를 믿으라는 건가요?: You expect us to trust someone who has killed people?
Whether you believe me is your choice.
And they were people who would have to die by my hand someday.
strings.당신에게 그런 일이 일어난 건 안타깝지만, 그렇다고 해서 사람을 죽인 건: I'm sorry for what happened to you. But that doesn't justify killing people...
strings.내 손으로 누군가를 죽인다는 건 결코 기분 좋은 일이 아니다. 하지만,: Taking a life with my own hands brings me no pleasure. But I... have no other choice.
strings.이도 저도 아닌 상태로 존재 자체를 부정당하고, 눈 앞에서 가족이 죽어갔: Caught between two worlds, my very existence was denied, and my family died before my eyes. You expect me to stand by after that?
strings.지금까지 내 기억은 부정으로, 내 시간은 고통으로 가득찼지만…, 어떤 것: My memories have been filled with rejection, my time with suffering... And nothing could compensate me for it.
strings.죽음에도 납득할 수 있는 마무리가 필요한데…, 난 그런 준비가 되어 있지: Even death needs an ending one can accept... I was not prepared for that...
strings.(그 순간, 멀린이 클로리스를 향해 피스톨을 겨눈다.): (At that moment, Merlin points his pistol at Chloris.)
strings.(놀란 모험가가 서둘러 멀린을 향해 뛰어가지만, 이미 서늘한 총구에서 강: (The startled adventurer rushes toward Merlin, but flames have already burst from the cold muzzle with deafening reports.)
strings.(그러나 탄환은 클로리스에게 닿기도 전에 가로막혀 바닥으로 떨어진다.): (The bullets are stopped before they reach Chloris and fall to the ground.)
(The enormous plant stems and leaves in front of Chloris scatter and disappear.)
The spell I prepared earlier saved me.
Whew... Thank goodness. But even so, I don't think I can forgive this.
strings.(%s의 큰 소리와 함께 강한 공격이 멀린에게 향한다. 하지만, %s의: (With a loud cry, %s strikes powerfully at Merlin. But the instant %s's attack meets his shield, it rebounds harmlessly.)
I'd like to indulge you, but not now...
strings.(놀란 클로리스가 %s에게 다가가는 동안, 멀린이 등을 돌려 원래 있던: (As a startled Chloris approaches %s, Merlin turns and leaps back onto the hill.)
strings.모르가나에게 들었다. 신이 아끼는 사람이라고…. 묻고 싶은 게 있었는데,: Morgana told me you are someone a god cherishes... I had something I wanted to ask, but it would be pointless anyway.
The gods of Etoile ceased to be gods the moment they fled...
Sigh. I must finish first so Morgana can do her part.
strings.아직 일어나지 않은 일이지만, 막고 싶다면 나보다 먼저 별의 노래의 끝에: It has not happened yet. But if you wish to stop it, you must reach the end of the Song of the Star before I do.
strings.(그 말과 함께 멀린이 언덕에서 내려와 어딘가를 향해 뛰어간다. %s 일: (With those words, Merlin descends the hill and runs off. %s and their companion hurry after him, but he is already out of sight.)
strings.%s 씨, 멀린이 간 방향 말고 다른 쪽으로 갈까요?: %s, shall we take a different direction from Merlin?
strings.멀린이 자기보다 먼저 도착해야 할 거라고 말한 건, 길을 모르기 때문이에: He said we'd have to arrive before him because he doesn't know the way. Neither do we, so we may as well try another direction.
This must be the first time here for all of us. That makes sense.
I'll follow the magic flowing through this place. Stay with me.
strings.(멀린의 말이 좀 걸려. 아직 일어나지 않는 일….): (Something about Merlin's words bothers me. Something that hasn't happened yet...)
strings.(빛나는 별과 달조각이 떨어진 언덕길을 따라 한참을 달려나갔을 때, 멀리: (After running for some time along hills strewn with glowing star and moon fragments, we see a structure in the distance that seems out of place.)
strings.(하얀색 석관 주위를 감싸는 별나무 뿌리와 줄기, 그리고 주위에 빛나는: (Roots and stems of star trees surround a white stone coffin. With the shining star fragments around it, the place feels deeply sacred.)
I sense a powerful force there.
strings.리프 소장님께서 말씀하신 힘이 저기 있는 걸까요?: Could that be the power Director Lif mentioned?
strings.(클로리스와 함께 석관에 다가가는 순간, 석관에 기대 앉아있던 멀린과 눈: (As I approach the stone coffin with Chloris, we meet Merlin's gaze. He has been sitting against it.)
strings.(멀린이 자리에서 일어나 뒤로 물러나는 %s 일행을 바라본다.): (Merlin rises and watches %s and their companion step back.)
strings.저 여자를 앞세워서 여기까지 온 건 좋은 선택이었다. 사라진 별의 노래,: Having that woman lead you here was a good choice. The power flowing through the Song of the Vanished Star is only...
