Wait. What do you mean? If you're going to say something, finish it.
There's no point in a human hearing it...
strings.먼저 내 질문에 답해라. 그리고 날 쓰러뜨려라. 그러면 너희가 원하는 답: First, answer my question. Then defeat me. If you do, I'll give you the answers you want.
And whichever we choose, Chloris, the outcome is the same for us.
strings.너희들은 리프트라시르의 위선적인 엘프들이 가치가 있다고 생각하는가?: Do you believe Lifthrasir's hypocritical elves have any worth?
What sort of absurd question is that...?
strings.다시 한번 묻겠다. 리프트라시르는 그만한 가치가 있다고 생각하는가?: I'll ask again. Do you believe Lifthrasir is worth it?
strings.그 가치를 누가 판단하는 거죠?: Who gets to decide its worth?
So that is your answer. Even though they are not worth your protection...
strings.(멀린이 조용히 눈을 감은 채로 피스톨을 만지작거린다.): (Merlin quietly closes his eyes and toys with his pistol.)
strings.모르가나…. 내가 리프트라시르에게 복수의 끝을 완성하고, 네가 아즈라엘: Morgana... The day has come for me to complete my revenge on Lifthrasir, and for you to return to Azrael.
strings.(두 사람이 곧 일어날 일을 대비하기 위해 물러나던 그때, 멀린이 눈을: (As the two step back to prepare for what is coming, Merlin opens his eyes. Black wings, invisible moments before, grow from his back.)
strings.에트와르와 사람들의 기억에서 영원히 존재하지 않도록 만들어주지…. 리프트: I will erase you forever from Etoile and its people's memories... Fools who will share Lifthrasir's fate.
strings.(멀리서 멀린의 공격을 방어하느라 마력을 모두 소진한 클로리스가 정신을: (Having exhausted her magic defending against Merlin's attacks from afar, Chloris loses consciousness and collapses.)
strings.(%s의 머리 위로 싸늘하고 차가운 금속의 느낌이 다가온다.): (A cold, hard touch of metal presses against %s's head.)
strings.넌 내가 멈출 수 있을 거라 생각하는 건가? 멈출 수 있다면 진작에 멈췄: Do you think I can stop? If I could, I would have stopped long ago.
strings.차라리 죽음 앞에서 다른 위선자들처럼 목숨을 구걸해. 그게 더 괜찮은 방: Instead, beg for your life like the other hypocrites facing death. That would be a better approach.
strings.네가 아끼는 신의 이름을 부르며 원망하고 저주해라. 그리고 무릎꿇고 빌어: Call the name of the god you cherish. Blame her and curse her. Then kneel and beg. Beg me to spare you!
strings.(표정을 읽을 수 없던 멀린에게서 격양된 발언이 이어진다.): (Merlin's previously unreadable expression gives way to heated words.)
I don't want to call Iris that way...
At the very least, my future isn't ending here and now.
strings.너는 이미 구원받았군. 구원이 구원인 것도 모르는 멍청이 주제에…. 크하: You've already been saved. You fool, you don't even recognize salvation for what it is... Hahahaha...
strings.(멀린이 손으로 화상을 입은 얼굴 부분을 가리며 미친듯이 웃는다.): (Merlin covers the burned part of his face with a hand and laughs wildly.)
strings.많은 생명이 불행 앞에 신에게 구원을 바랐다. 죽어가면서도 신의 이름을: So many lives begged the gods for salvation in the face of misery. Even as they died, they cried out the gods' names and pleaded again and again.
strings.위선자일수록 신의 이름을 더하고 더하면서 외쳤지. 제발 살려주세요. 돈과: The greater the hypocrite, the more gods' names they shouted. 'Please spare me!' They clung to me, promising money and offerings!
strings.내 손으로 심판한 자들도, 억울하게 죽어간 자들도, 신 앞에선 모두 공평: Those I judged with my own hands, and those who died unjustly, were all equal before the gods. They all died.
strings.나에게 충고를 할 자격이 있다고 생각하는 것 같군. 오만한 인간…. 그러: You seem to think you're entitled to lecture me. Arrogant human... Then what is that power you possess?
strings.신의 가호라고 해도 지금의 네 힘은 누군가의 죽음값으로 이뤄낸 힘일 것이: Even if you call it a god's blessing, your present power must have been bought with someone's death.
So what Morgana told me was true. A vile hypocrite...
Remember this well, %s... How empty and accursed your words are...
strings.(그렇게 멀린이 피스톨을 쥔 손가락에 힘을 실는 순간, 뒤쪽에서 누군가: (As Merlin tightens his finger on the pistol, someone suddenly pops up behind him.)
strings.(놀자며 얼굴을 들이미는 모드레드의 등장에 멀린의 자세가 흐트러진다.): (Mordred thrusts her face forward, demanding to play, and throws Merlin off balance.)
Merlin, Merlin! Can I do it? Morgan said this would be fun.
strings.(모드레드가 고개를 끄덕이자마자 환한 미소로 멀린을 스쳐 지나간다.): (Mordred nods, then slips past Merlin with a bright smile.)
(With a sharp bursting sound, black splashes fill %s's vision.)
strings.(멀린이 피를 토한채로 겨우 자세를 잡고 있지만, 금방이라도 쓰러질 것처: (Coughing up blood, Merlin barely holds himself upright. He looks ready to collapse at any moment.)
strings.미안, 멀린. 모르간이 필요한 게 있다고 그랬는 걸. 그건 바로 바로!: Sorry, Merlin. Morgan said she needed something. And that something is... demon blood hungry for anger and revenge!
strings.(모드레드 스스로도 꺼낸 이야기가 뭔지 모르겠는지 머리를 긁적거린다. 그: (Mordred scratches her head, seemingly unsure what her own words mean. Then she opens a potion bottle she has somehow brought over and peers inside.)
strings.흐음. 좋은 피! 멀린의 피가 여기 들어가면 좋은 거랬어!: Hmm. Good blood! She said it would be good if Merlin's blood went in here!
strings.(모드레드의 창 끝에 흐르는 검은 피가 떨어지더니 이내 포션 병에 채워진: (Black blood drips from the tip of Mordred's spear, filling the potion bottle.)
All she needed was my blood... Gah...
strings.(멀린이 허망한 표정으로 그대로 주저앉는다.): (Merlin sinks to the ground with an empty expression.)
strings.에…, 조금 모자라네. 모르간, 자물쇠 피도 뽑아도 돼?: Hmm... Not quite enough. Morgan, can I take Lock's blood too?
strings.(모드레드가 %s의 얼굴을 바라보다가 누군가에게 질문을 던진다. 그러자: (Mordred looks at %s's face and asks someone a question. Morgana's voice answers as though she were right beside them.)
strings.다른 피는 필요없어요, 모드레드. 그리고 그 사람은 열쇠였어요. 자물쇠가: We don't need any other blood, Mordred. And that person was a key, not a lock. In any case, bring Merlin's blood back.
strings.아, 맞다. 열쇠라고 했었네? 이힛. 그래도 자물쇠가 더 귀여워! 너 자: Oh, right! You said key! Hehe. But Lock is cuter! You're Lock-Key! I'm going to Morgan now! We'll play together later, okay?!
strings.(아직 긴장을 늦출 순 없어. 아직 클로리스 씨가….): (I can't lower my guard yet. Chloris is still...)
strings.(모드레드가 손을 흔들며 인사를 하자, 등 뒤에서 검은 그림자 하나가 솟: (Mordred waves goodbye. A black shadow rises behind her, wraps around her, and carries her away.)
strings.멀린, 왜? 난 네 바람대로 해준 것 뿐이야. 나는 너의 복수를 돕겠다고: Why, Merlin? I only did what you wished. I said I would help with your revenge.
strings.(모르가나가 목소리를 낼 때마다 검은 그림자가 커졌다 작아지기를 반복한다: (With each word from Morgana, the black shadow swells and contracts.)
strings.네 피가 내 뜻과 네 뜻대로 해줄 거야. 날 믿어. 네 복수는 이제 곧: Your blood will fulfill both my wish and yours. Trust me. Your revenge will soon be complete. Trust me...
strings.그런 너는 날 얼마나 믿었지?: And how much did you trust me?
strings.불안한 감정의 기억을 믿음으로 덮어씌워주고, 아서가 남긴 힘까지 줬는데,: I covered your memories of anxiety with trust and even gave you the power Arthur left behind. Apparently, it wasn't enough.
strings.잠깐…. 지금의 난…. 내 기억은….?: Wait... What am I now...? My memories...?
strings.떠올리지 않아도 돼, 멀린. 그리고 이제 돌려받을게. 나는 이제 네가 필: You don't need to remember, Merlin. And now I'll take it back. I have no further need of you...
strings.(모르가나의 목소리가 사라지고, 멀린의 움직임이 멈춘다. 잠시 후, 별의: (Morgana's voice fades, and Merlin stops moving. Soon the Song of the Star fills with his screams.)
strings.(언젠가 느껴봤었던 공포와 두려움… 이건….): (The terror and dread I felt once before... This is...)
strings.(멀린이 고통스러워할수록 모드레드의 공격으로 입은 상처 틈에서 검은 피가: (As Merlin's pain grows, black blood continues pouring from the wound Mordred inflicted.)
(The blood on the ground slowly begins erasing the light from the glittering space.)
Th-this is... B-Binding... Different from back then...
strings.%s, 이제 당신이 뭐라고 해도 날 막을 수 없어요. 모든 준비를 마친: %s, whatever you say now, you cannot stop me. My preparations are complete. I will return. His time will send me there more quickly.
strings.내 손으로 복수하고 싶었는데…, 이런 결말을 원하는 건… 아니었단 걸……: I wanted revenge by my own hands... This wasn't... the ending I wanted...
strings.(멀린에게서 더는 아무런 말도 들려오지 않는다. 어떤 움직임도 보이지 않: (No more words come from Merlin. He does not move.)
strings.아서가 하려고 했던 것처럼 리프트라시르의 모든 생명이 증발하고 성당 안에: Just as Arthur intended, every life in Lifthrasir will vanish, and all the power within the cathedral will disappear.
strings.닥쳐라, 마녀! 감히 네가 이곳을 망치려 드느냐! 네 뜻대로 되지는 않을: Silence, witch! How dare you try to ruin this place! You will not have your way!
strings.(그런 그때, %s의 앞으로 리프가 나타난다.): (At that moment, Lif appears in front of %s.)
The hero's coffin has been tainted with demon blood. That power will never return...
strings.(리프가 살짝 윙크하자 관 주위에 흘렀던 검은 액체들이 흔적도 없이 사라: (Lif gives a slight wink, and the black liquid around the coffin vanishes without a trace.)
What an interesting elf. There's no power left here anyway, so I'll withdraw. You, too, will vanish tonight.
strings.(할 말을 마친 모르가나의 목소리가 사라지고, 공간의 일부를 가득 채웠던: (Morgana finishes speaking and falls silent. The black shadow filling part of the space disappears as well.)
Whew... A moment to breathe. Come to your senses, %s.
strings.멀린은 제가 수습할 테니까 클로리스 학원장과 함께 여길 나가 성당으로 가: I'll take care of Merlin. Leave here with Headmistress Chloris and go to the cathedral.
strings.불멸의 사제단이 성당으로 갔어요. 아마도 마녀의 힘이 그곳에서 느껴졌겠죠: The Immortal Priesthood has gone there. They must have sensed the witch's power.
strings.그리고 여신이시여. 부족한 이 엘프를 이끄소서…. 다시는 과오가 반복되지: And Goddess, guide this unworthy elf... I will strive never to repeat my mistakes...
strings.(리프의 작은 목소리와 함께 별의 노래 안에 있던 별 구조물들이 환하게: (As Lif speaks softly, the star-shaped structures within the Song of the Star begin shining brightly. One by one, they erase everything around them.)
strings.(주위의 풍경이 처음 그때처럼 아름답고 밝은 빛으로 가득하다. 모험가가: (The surroundings are filled with beautiful, brilliant light, just as at the beginning. Only then does the adventurer take stock of the situation and look at Chloris as though nothing is wrong.)
%s, you acted so naturally that you startled me.
Anyway, whatever the director did seems to have awakened and healed me...
strings.보세요. 괜찮아 보이죠?: Look. I seem all right, don't I?
strings.(클로리스가 아무렇지도 않은 것처럼 한쪽 팔을 들어보인다.): (Chloris raises one arm as though nothing has happened.)
strings.소장님이 말씀하신대로 빨리 성당으로 가요. 자세한 건 성당으로 가는 길에: Let's hurry to the cathedral, as the director said. I'll explain everything on the way!
strings.(클로리스가 정신을 잃었던 시간동안 일어난 일을 알게 되자 슬픈 표정을: (When Chloris learns what took place while she was unconscious, her expression saddens.)
I don't know what to say... Sigh...
I can feel Zephyros's magic inside.
If I were to guess from what Morgana said...
strings.바이스의 힘은 시간의 정령이 사는 장소를 흔들었어요. 그래서 틈이 생겨: Weiss's power shook the place where the spirit of time lives. A rift formed, and the flow of time from within spilled out and affected the Windy Seed...
Then that Windy Seed transformed both of you.
strings.저에게 그 영향의 여파가 남아있어요. 아마 제피로스도 그럴 거예요. 저와: Some of its effects remain in me. Zephyros is probably the same. Unlike me, he still holds part of the power of time...
Ah! Morgana said his time would send her back more quickly.
Morgana will return faster using Zephyros's time... Zephy, no...
strings.모르가나가 제피로스를 촉매로 쓰려고 해요. 그 과정에서 마력을 모두 잃: She's planning to use him as a catalyst. He mustn't lose all his magic in the process.
strings.(클로리스가 서둘러 성당 안으로 들어가려고하는 순간, 그 안에서 부드럽고: (As Chloris hurries toward the cathedral entrance, a soft, warm wind blows from inside and pushes her back out.)
strings.(클로리스가 한 번 더 안으로 들어가려고 시도하지만, 마찬가지. 계속해서: (Chloris tries to enter again, but the same thing happens. The wind keeps blowing, preventing her from going inside.)
strings.제가 모르가나를 막아내고, 제피로스 님과 함께 밖으로 나올 테니까 기다려: I'll stop Morgana and bring Zephyros out with me. Wait for us.
But just in case, if a long time passes and I don't come back...
All right, I won't. Please trust me and wait.
(Still... How am I going to find them in a cathedral this big? I'd better go in first.)
strings.(성당 안으로 들어가자 시야를 가득 채울 정도로 거대하고 웅장한 느낌의: (Inside the cathedral, enormous, majestic structures fill my view.)
strings.엄청나네…. 숲 한쪽에 이런 건물을 세울 생각을 다 하다니…. 아, 이: Incredible... Who would think to build something like this in a corner of the forest...? No, there's no time for that. I have to hurry.
(Mordred appears beside the running %s and begins running along with them.)
Play with me! Let's play together~!
strings.흥, 아서하고는 놀아줬으면서!: Hmph. But you played with Arthur!
strings.(아서라는 말에 %s의 발걸음이 자연스레 멈춘다.): (At the name Arthur, %s's steps come to a halt.)
strings.너는 바이스 때문에 날 알고 있는 거야? 언제부터 알았어?: Do you know me because of Weiss? Since when?
strings.아! 아서가 에트와르에 온 순간부터다!: Oh! Since the moment Arthur came to Etoile!
So you've been with Weiss since then...
No, no. I was only born recently.
strings.나? 대답하면 놀아줄 거야?: Me? Will you play with me if I answer?
strings.헤헤, 나는 아서의 기억을 인자로 구성한 다음, 그걸로 모르가나가 만든: Hehe. I'm a homunculus Morgana made using Arthur's memories, arranged into the components that make me.
strings.(모드레드가 경계 태세를 취하는 %s의 모습을 보고도 계속해서 놀아달라: (Even as %s takes a defensive stance, Mordred keeps demanding to play. Then Morgana's voice comes from somewhere.)
strings.모드레드, 멋대로 그런 걸 말해버리다니…. 내가 그러지 말라고 했죠?: Mordred, telling them that without permission... I told you not to, didn't I?
strings.아서의 친구니까, %s, 내 친구야!: Arthur's friend means %s is my friend!
It wasn't the intended result, but our Mordred has turned out a little like this...
Yep, that's just how I am, Lock-Key. Hehe.
Mordred, no playing here. Play hide-and-seek inside instead.
Ah... There must be no hide-and-seek in Arthur's memories... Then I'll teach you.
strings.숨는 사람이 모드레드, 찾는 사람이 %s, 찾는 사람을 술래라고 하는 거: Mordred will hide, and %s will look for you. The person who looks is called the seeker.
strings.모드레드는 적당히 숨어있다가 술래가 나타나면 죽이세요. 재미있겠죠?: Hide somewhere, Mordred, and when the seeker appears, kill them. Won't that be fun?
strings.응, 응!! 재미있을 것 같아! 그러면 자물열쇠가 술래! 나 가서 숨을게: Yes, yes!! That sounds fun! Then Lock-Key is the seeker! I'll go hide!
strings.(말도 안되는 숨바꼭질의 규칙을 들은 모드레드가 환호하면서 저 멀리 사라: (Cheering at the absurd rules of hide-and-seek, Mordred disappears into the distance.)
strings.%s, 이제 내가 왜곡된 기억을 심어준 존재들이 당신을 향해 달려들 거예: %s, beings whose memories I've distorted will now rush toward you.
Without even knowing that everything in Lifthrasir is going to disappear.
strings.전 당신을 기다리지 않아요. 당신이 도착하기도 전에 난 이미 돌아가 있을: I won't be waiting for you. I'll already be home before you arrive.
strings.(모르가나의 목소리가 사라지면서 대신 마녀의 저주로 왜곡된 기억을 품게: (Morgana's voice fades, and beings whose memories have been twisted by the witch's curse begin swarming in.)
strings.(성스러운 빛이 가득하다 못해 눈부신 빛이 가득한 공간 사이로 이질적인: (An out-of-place figure walks through a space so full of sacred light that it is dazzling.)
strings.(그러다 문득 창 밖으로 수정달 숲의 풍경이 보이자 창가로 다가간다.): (Noticing Crystal Moon Forest through a window, she approaches it.)
strings.이 세계에 와서 한 번도 아름답다 생각해본 적이 없었는데…, 아즈라엘만큼: Since coming to this world, I've never once thought it beautiful... But it is as beautiful as Azrael...
strings.아서는 가엽게도 이 세계의 아름다움을 알지 못하고 사라졌지만, 후훗. 난: Poor Arthur disappeared without ever knowing this world's beauty. But... Hehe. I am happy.
strings.칠흑보다 어두운 자의 피도 얻었고, 촉매로 사용될 시간의 힘도 있어. 이: I have the blood of one darker than pitch, and the power of time to serve as a catalyst. Now I only need to wait here, where sacred power remains...
strings.(그때, 예배당의 문을 열고 누군가 걸어 들어오자 모르가나의 얼굴에 그림: (Then someone opens the chapel door and enters, casting a shadow over Morgana's face.)
Morgana the witch. So you were waiting.
You've arrived sooner than I expected, %s...
strings.(기다렸냐는 %s의 말에 모르가나의 표정이 미세하게 떨린다.): (Morgana's expression twitches slightly at %s's suggestion that she was waiting.)
Who would have thought the cathedral's most important place was at the very top?
You've done well to reach me. Few children are as unwilling to give up as Mordred...
strings.이런 숨바꼭질은 처음이지만, 그래도 나쁘지 않았어. 피하느라 고생을 좀: I've never played hide-and-seek like that before, but it wasn't so bad. Dodging her was a little difficult...
I created Mordred from Arthur's memories at the height of his strength. Comparatively, she should be stronger than the Requiem Arthur made.
strings.아서가 다른 시간대의 죄인을 만나고, 다른 시간대에 간섭하면서 많이 도움: It helped greatly when Arthur met a sinner from another timeline and interfered with another time. Chimera, was it...?
Hehe. You seem surprised. I thought you knew...
strings.자비로운 멀린의 뜻에 따라 한 번만 더 권유할까 하는데, 당신 뜻은 어떤: In accordance with merciful Merlin's wishes, I might offer you one last chance. What do you say?
If that's how you understand it, go ahead.
...I don't trust you. You've already shown me everything I need to see...
strings.멀린에게 했던 것들 말씀이시죠?: You mean what I did to Merlin?
strings.멀린이 알고도 받아들였는데, 뭐가 문제일까요? 세계는 다 그렇게 돌아가요: Merlin knew and accepted it. What's the problem? That's how the world works.
strings.당신이 믿었던 것이 한 번에 무너질 수 있고, 일어설 수도 있어요. 종이: What you believe in can collapse in an instant, or rise again. The difference is paper-thin.
strings.나는 당신이 지금 여기까지 올라온 것도 다르지 않다 생각해요. 당신만의: I don't think your coming all the way here is any different. You have your own purpose and wishes...
Morgana... You spout contradictions just like Weiss.
If only you had become a key, Arthur and I would already be home...
...Then again, if you thought clearly, you wouldn't have done any of this.
Waiting was becoming tedious... You've arrived at a good moment.
As for me, I'll end everything connected to Weiss here, with you.
Right and wrong no longer matter.
strings.어리석은 당신을 아무도 기억하지 못하게, 어떤 시간에도 흔적조차 머무를: I will make sure no one remembers you, foolish creature. Not a trace of you will remain in any time.
I didn't expect you to hold out this long. This will be the last...
strings.(틈이 있을진 모르겠지만, 그걸 노리는 수밖에….): (I don't know whether there'll be an opening, but I have to watch for one...)
strings.(모르가나가 펜던트에서 빛을 흘려 무기로 만들려는 순간, 빛이 점차 어둡: (As Morgana draws light from the pendant to shape into a weapon, the light slowly darkens and stops moving.)
strings.(모르가나가 당황했는지 펜던트를 쥐고 흔들지만, 검게 변해버린 빛은 원래: (Flustered, Morgana grips and shakes the pendant, but the blackened light does not return to normal.)
...I don't know what's happening, but let's end this.
strings.(방금 전까지만 해도 많은 공격을 쏟아내던 모르가나가 무력하게도 %s에게: (Morgana, who was unleashing attack after attack only moments ago, is powerless as %s takes her pendant.)
This seems to be the tool that amplifies your abilities. I'll deal with it properly, as you said.
strings.(모르가나의 외침에도 불구하고 땅에 떨어진 펜던트는 %s의 공격에 의해: (Despite Morgana's cry, %s's attack destroys the pendant on the ground. The black light around Morgana and the pendant grows faint.)
strings.(잠시 후, 안으로 유리 깨지는 소리가 연이어 들려오기 시작한다.): (Soon, the sound of breaking glass begins echoing repeatedly from within.)
strings.모드레드!! 이리로 와요!! 여기 와서 당신의 놀이 상대를 죽여버려요!!: Mordred!! Come here!! Come and kill your playmate!!
strings.(모르가나가 흥분을 감추지 못하고 있을 때, 뒤에서 큰 그림자 장막이 피: (As Morgana struggles to contain her agitation, a great curtain of shadow rises behind her. A large staff wrapped in plant stems emerges and taps her shoulder.)
strings.모드레드, 빨리 와. 저, 저 여잘 죽여!! 왜 대답이 없어?: Mordred, hurry! Kill that... that woman!! Why aren't you answering?
strings.당신의 힘을 좀 빌렸죠. 기억을 조작하고, 공간을 왜곡시키는 당신의 능력: I borrowed a little of your power. Your ability to manipulate memories and distort space...
strings.(어디선가 들어본 목소리…, 설마….): (A voice I've heard before... Could it be...?)
I sent her into the eternity of play she longs for.
strings.(모르가나의 앞으로 보랏빛의 투구가 하나 떨어진다.): (A purple helmet falls in front of Morgana.)
strings.누군가의 기억을 바탕으로 만들어진 생명…. 다시 태어난 건 아니지만 꼭…: A life made from someone's memories... Not truly reborn, but so very like...
strings.(모르가나가 바닥에 떨어진 투구를 보고 주저앉아 끌어안는다. 잠시 후,: (Seeing the helmet on the floor, Morgana sinks down and hugs it. A moment later, the woman holding the staff behind her slowly steps forward.)
strings.이렇게 보는 건 처음인가요? 저와 인사하지 않고 싶겠지만, 제대로 소개는: Is this your first time seeing me like this? You may not wish to exchange greetings, but I should introduce myself properly.
(The moment the woman gives her name, the cathedral shakes violently again.)
Long ago, I was the leader of the Kali people...
Now I am merely one of the witches you know.
strings.(다프네가 미소를 짓자 주위에 알 수 없는 힘의 장벽이 세워진다. 마침,: (As Daphne smiles, a barrier of unknown power rises around her. The adventurer, rushing toward her, is thrown back.)
Hasty. Still, I'll give you credit for testing me.
I have no business with you today.
strings.…모르가나를 어떻게 할 거지?: ...What are you going to do to Morgana?
Give her the ending that awaits one fated to be a witch.
strings.(다프네의 말이 끝나는 순간, 시야의 모든 것이 일그러진다.): (The moment Daphne finishes speaking, everything in view distorts.)
Don't be afraid, %s. This isn't Binding.
strings.(다프네가 아직도 주저앉은 채로 투구를 감싸안은 모르가를 바라본다.): (Daphne looks at Morgana, who is still sitting on the ground, clutching the helmet.)
How those who tamper with life end...
Yes. I will meet my end someday as well. But not now. Now...
strings.사, 살려줘. 나…, 나는…. 여기 오고 싶어서 온 게 아니야. 눈 떠보: S-spare me. I... I didn't come here because I wanted to. I opened my eyes and found myself here. But... but!!
strings.빌어먹을 검은 달이 날 이렇게 만들었다고! 강제로 마녀를 만들어 버렸어…: That damned black moon made me like this! It forced me to become a witch...
strings.비록 다른 시간이지만, 아서가 성공하면 돌아갈 수 있었는데…. 이번에도: Though it was another time, I could have returned if Arthur had succeeded... I thought I'd succeed this time and go home...
strings.그래서 이곳의 생명을 이용하려 했군요. 아발론에 찌꺼기 같이 남아있던 힘: So you tried to use the lives here. You gathered even the scraps of power left in Avalon. And you manipulated the memories of a young man living an ordinary life, awakening him as a high-ranking demon...
strings.모르가나…, 당신이 손댄 우리 일족의 숫자가 많아요. 그 수만큼 당신은: Morgana... You have harmed many of my people. For every one of them, you will now...
strings.(다프네가 자신을 바라보는 모르가나의 얼굴을 바라본다. 그리고 들고 있던: (Daphne meets Morgana's gaze, then taps her shoulder with the staff.)
(Behind the barrier, Morgana's figure fractures into many pieces like a shattering mirror.)
strings.(그리고 그 조각들은 커다란 굉음과 함께 솟아올라 바닥으로 떨어진다.): (The fragments surge upward with a thunderous crash, then fall to the floor.)
Daphne, what have you just done...?
I am a witch, after all.
strings.(다프네가 방금 전까지 모르가나였던 유리조각을 바라본다. 유리조각이 가루: (Daphne looks at the glass fragments that were Morgana moments ago. As they crumble into dust, she smiles in satisfaction.)
strings.(다프네가 펼쳐진 장벽을 사라지게 만들고 천천히 %s에게 다가온다.): (Daphne dismisses the barrier and slowly approaches %s.)
strings.기, 기억을 지울 셈이야?: A-are you going to erase my memories?
strings.마음대로 생각하세요. 당신에게는 기억이 지워지는 일이 가혹할 것 같긴 하: Think what you like. Though losing your memories would be cruel for you, I suppose.
strings.다프네, 뭘 위해서 이러는 거지?: Daphne, why are you doing this?
strings.솔직하게 말씀드릴까요?: Would you like an honest answer?
strings.(그 순간, 다프네와 %s의 주위로 어둠이 밀려오기 시작한다. 찬란했던: (At that moment, darkness begins closing in around Daphne and %s. It swallows everything, as though the cathedral with its radiant light had never existed.)
strings.움직여야 하는 운명의 마녀. 그게 저예요. 그리고 밤이 다가오기 전에 이: I am a witch whose fate compels her to act. And what I want is to change this star's fate before the night approaches...
(With the witch's smile visible through the darkness, %s's memories end.)
strings.(어둠만 가득했던 세상이 갑자기 밝은 빛으로 돌아오면서 서있던 모험가가: (The world of darkness suddenly returns to brilliant light, and the standing adventurer sinks to the floor.)
strings.분명 나는 모르가나와 싸우고, 펜던트를 빼앗아서 깨뜨렸고…. 그리고 다프: I fought Morgana, took her pendant, and smashed it... And then Daphne...
Ah! My memories... They haven't been erased.
Daphne said she would test Morgana's power...
Is this the person Director Lif mentioned...?
strings.(언제 왔는지 불멸의 사제단 사제들이 %s의 옆으로 다가온다.): (Priests of the Immortal Priesthood approach %s, seemingly from nowhere.)
strings.(방금 전까지 나를 공격하던 사제들이….): (The priests who were attacking me a moment ago...)
Oh, yes. I'm looking for someone...
Ah, that mage...? He has already returned to the village with the director.
strings.벌써라뇨? 돌아오시지 않는다고 해서 소장님과 함께 벌써 몇시간 째 찾았는: Already? You hadn't returned, so we've been searching for hours with the director. To think you were here...
The half-elf... I mean, your companion is waiting outside. Please go to her.
strings.그리고 감사합니다. 성당에 들었던 도둑들을 쫓아내주셔서. 덕분에 성당 물: And thank you for driving the thieves out of the cathedral. Thanks to you, we protected its treasures.
strings.(날 공격하려던 그 사람들은 도둑이었구나….): (So the people who tried to attack me were thieves...)
Whew... The priests will take care of the cathedral. I should go to Chloris.
strings.(그건 그렇고 밤이 다가온다는 건 발푸르기스의 밤이라는 거겠지….): (Still, the approaching night must mean Walpurgis Night...)
strings.(클로리스가 성당 밖으로 나오는 %s의 모습을 보고 달려간다.): (Chloris sees %s emerge from the cathedral and runs over.)
strings.…괜찮은 거예요? 다친 곳 없어요?: ...Are you all right? You're not hurt?
Yes, I'm fine. Please don't worry.
Were your memories erased? I was afraid you might not recognize me...
The teacher who destroyed the school...
strings.다행이다!! 제대로 기억하네요. 그런데 뭐요?: Thank goodness!! You remember properly. Wait, what did you say?
strings.학교는 못 부수니까 어디 한 군데 못 쓰게 해드릴까요?: I can't destroy the school, so shall I put some part of you out of commission instead?
The people inside the cathedral seem to be back to normal...
strings.맞아요. 다시 돌아와서 리프 소장님의 지시대로 흩어져서 %s 씨를 찾았어: Yes. They recovered and split up to search for you on Director Lif's orders. Where have you been all this time, %s?
strings.(클로리스에게 성당 상층 예배당에서 있었던 일을 이야기한다.): (I tell Chloris what happened in the chapel on the cathedral's upper floor.)
strings.다프네가 원래 기억을 지우는 능력이 있었는데…. 모르가나를 쓰러뜨리고 그: Daphne could already erase memories... But she defeated Morgana and inherited her ability?
I can't believe it... How is that...?
(A man who looks identical to Notos, yet has a slightly different air, steps out from behind a tree.)
strings.다른 색의 눈동자, 굳게 다문 입술, 뿔테 안경…. 좀 다르긴 한데 똑같: Different-colored eyes, tightly set lips, horn-rimmed glasses... A little different, yet just the same. Definitely twins...
strings.아, 제피…. 왔어, 괜찮아?: Ah, Zephy... You're here. Are you all right?
strings.난 아무렇지도 않아. 거기 %s, 이런 모습으로는 처음이겠지?: I'm perfectly fine. %s, this is your first time seeing me like this, isn't it?
All right, Zephyros. We've been looking for you.
strings.그렇게 시간이 지난 줄 몰랐어. 나는 마법서에 나온 내용대로 흐름을 찾아: I had no idea so much time had passed. I followed the flow described in a spellbook into the forest, and that was the last I knew...
You're far too relaxed. I... We spent so long searching...
strings.태평한 게 아니라 난 아무것도 몰랐잖아, 클로이. 말도 안되는 일이라고: I wasn't relaxed. I simply knew nothing, Chloe. I'd like to call the whole thing absurd, but I've already lived through it.
strings.나도 모르게 부엉, 부엉 거리는 이상한 시계와 말하는 고양이하고 대화를: Including, somehow, talking to a strange clock that kept hooting and a talking cat...
strings.끄응…. 이걸 말하면 미친 거라고 하고 싶겠지만 진짜란 말이야. 클로이…: Ugh... You'll think I'm mad, but it's true. Chloe...
Chloris, what Zephyros is saying is true.
strings.말하는 부엉이 시계와 고양이가 있는 정령 세계가 있어요. 나도 쉬고 싶다: There's a spirit world with a talking owl clock and a cat. 'I want to rest too, hoot.' 'I'm gonna have a nap.' That's how they talk.
...Chloe, it's written all over your face.
strings.하여튼, 클로이하고 %s에게 미안하다…. 나름 위험에서 벗어날 수 있는: Anyway, I'm sorry, Chloe and %s... I thought I could keep myself out of danger. I never imagined it would become such an incident...
strings.그런데 제피로스는 정신을 차렸을 때 어디였어요?: Where were you when you regained consciousness, Zephyros?
strings.…성당의 상층 다락방이었다. 누군가 걸어놓은 결계의 흔적이 있었는데, 마: ...In an attic on the cathedral's upper floor. There were traces of a barrier someone had placed there. So it was a witch's work...
strings.%s, 할말이 있다. 여기서 할 말은 아니라 나중에 학원 본관을 찾아줬으: %s, there's something I need to tell you. Not here. I'd like you to visit the academy's main building later...
strings.무슨 이야기인지 살짝 알 수 있을까요?: Could you give me an idea what it's about?
strings.그동안 내가 조사했던 마법청과 마법청이 했던 일, 그리고 앞으로 할 일…: The Magic Bureau I've been investigating, what it has done, and what it plans to do...
I'll send you a message when the time comes...
Understood. I'll visit the Magic Academy then.
Oh, Director Lif said she has something to tell you when you return to the village...
We'll head straight back to the Magic Academy, %s...
See you later, %s. We have something to discuss here for a moment.
Then I'll go to the village and see the director. I'll see you both later...
strings.(모험가가 마을로 떠난 후, 성당에 있던 사제들도 탐정으로 위장한 도둑들: (After the adventurer leaves for the village, the cathedral's priests also depart, taking the thieves disguised as detectives with them.)
strings.이제 좀 조용해지겠다. 그치?: It'll finally be a little quieter. Right?
strings.먼저 미안하단 말을 할게. 이제 네가 마법청을 떠날 수밖에 없었던 이유를: First, I want to apologize. I'm going to tell you why you had no choice but to leave the Magic Bureau...
strings.(벤치에 앉아있던 리프가 고개를 뒤로 대고 하늘을 바라본다. 그러던 중,: (Seated on a bench, Lif leans her head back and looks at the sky. Then she notices %s.)
strings.(리프가 의자에서 일어나 %s의 손을 잡는다.): (Lif rises from the bench and takes %s's hand.)
Thank you for protecting the village...
strings.너무 겸손해할 필요 없어요. 나중에라도 노후는 우리 마을에서 보내준다면야: No need to be so modest. Though I'd be grateful if you spent your retirement in our village someday...
strings.네…. 마음이 뭔가 허전해져서 이상한 농담을 계속하게 되네요. 미안해요…: Yes... My heart feels a little empty, so I keep making strange jokes. I'm sorry...
strings.성당에서 마녀 둘을 만나고 별일 없었다는 건 알고 있지만, 그래도 혹시: I knew you'd met two witches in the cathedral and were unharmed, but I sent the priests to look for you just in case.
strings.감사해요. 어, 그런데…. 하실 말씀이…. 그리고, 마녀 둘을 만난 건: Thank you. Oh, but... You had something to say...? And how did you know I met two witches?
strings.저는 이 마을의 촌장이에요. 수정달 숲을 바탕으로 한 기억들을 미약하지만: I am this village's chief. I can faintly sense the memories rooted in Crystal Moon Forest.
strings.먼길을 떠났던 용사가 다시 마을로 돌아온 순간부터, 이곳은 제 삶 그 자: Ever since the hero returned from his long journey, this place has been my very life.
strings.(잘은 모르겠지만, 뭔가 대단한 걸 들은 것 같네.): (I don't fully understand, but I feel I've just heard something extraordinary.)
Thank you for helping us in the Song of the Star. But what happened to Merlin...?
strings.별의 노래, 땅에 스며든 밝은 별들은 수정달 숲에서 살아간 모든 생명의: The bright stars that have soaked into the ground of the Song of the Star are the memories of every life lived in Crystal Moon Forest. Our departed ancestors are there too.
strings.그래서 멀린, 아니 살레온을 어머니의 옆에 머물게 했어요. 작은 별, 큰: So I laid Merlin... no, Saleon, beside his mother. A little star and a great star...
I wanted to tell him Maria was there... But I was too late.
It's all right. You did everything you could...
strings.그리고 아셔야 될게 있어서 한가지를 더 말씀드릴게요. 이걸 뭐라고 해야할: There's one more thing you should know. I'm not sure how to explain it... It's so strange.
strings.저는 다 기억하지만, 리프트라시르 주민과 다른 사람들은…. 살레온과 관련: I remember everything. But the Lifthrasir residents and the others... All their memories connected to Saleon have been erased. Even those of the people he killed.
strings.그리고 하프엘프가 불길하다고 다들 꺼려했던 것과 인간을 적대시 하던 사제: And their fear of half-elves as ill omens, and the priests' hostility toward humans... As though none of it had ever existed...
strings.다프네라는 마녀가 어떻게든 자신의 방법으로 해결한 것 같지만…. 이걸 뭐: The witch Daphne seems to have resolved it somehow, in her own way... But what should I call that...?
It makes me a little sad that these memories remain only with certain people.
Daphne changed Lifthrasir's memories like this... What could she be thinking?
strings.후우…. 저는 저대로 어떻게든 할 거예요. 10년 전, 다들 악몽처럼 여: Sigh... I'll find my own way through this. We managed to get through the memories everyone regarded as a nightmare ten years ago.
strings.이젠 이게 옳은 건지 틀린 건지 상관없어요. 어차피 사람은 자기가 편한대: I no longer care whether this is right or wrong. People remember things however it suits them anyway.
I'll rest for just a few days. Without thinking about anything... Just a few days...
strings.아, 제 이야기만 했네요. 그런데, 제 이야기 때문에 기분이 가라앉은 건: Oh, I've only talked about myself. I haven't made you feel down, have I?
My feelings are complicated. A little like yours, but a little different too...
You must have been through a great deal.
strings.(리프가 %s의 눈동자를 보고 뭔가 느꼈는지 고개를 끄덕인다.): (Lif looks into %s's eyes and nods, as though sensing something.)
You seem to need rest too... Take some time off and stop worrying. We'll provide everything you need while you're here.
strings.(사람은 자기 편한대로 기억한다는 소장님 말씀…. 모르가나도, 멀린도 다: (The director said people remember things however it suits them... I think that was true of Morgana and Merlin too. And of me...)
strings.(설마, 이게 답인 걸까? 아직은 모르겠어….): (Could that be the answer? I still don't know...)
strings.(그동안 모습을 보이지 않았던 다프네가 나온 걸 보면 분명 무슨 일이 있: (Daphne appeared after staying out of sight for so long. Something must be happening...)
strings.(좀 쉬다가 이리스를 찾아가야겠어. 괜찮다고 했으니 분명 괜찮을 테지만…: (I should rest a little, then visit Iris. They said she was all right, so I'm sure she is. But still...)
